75.translation: Alla - alaa dewum so O, Gonɗo nguurndam, Jokkiɗo [fow] ngonka. Ɓurnduki walla pillaaki heɓataa O. O ndan ko woni kule e ko woni leydi. Moye waawota yeewtude e O so yaynnde O? O anndi ko woni yeeso maɓɓe e ko ɓaawo maɓɓe, ɓe kaƴƴitaani hay huunde e ganndal O so ko O yiɗi. Kursi O yaajni kule e leydi, toppitaago ɗi mettataa O. O ko Toowɗo, Mawɗo.

76.translation: ([Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)]( 1 )   Wien, O ko Alla, [ngo] Gooto,( 2 )   Alla, Duuɓiɗo Ndaaɓli.( 3 )   O jibinaani, o jibinaa,( 4 )   alaa potɗo e O.)([Soorah al-Falaq (113)] ( 1 )   Wien, miɗo yaha kaldugo Joom duunyal( 2 )   bonan ko O tagi( 3 )   e bonan nimre nde nde naati( 4 )   e bonan ɓuuɓɓuɓe nder koole( 5 )   e bonan ḥaasowoowo nde o ḥaasini. )([Soorah an-Naas (114)])( 1 )   Wien, miɗo yaha kaldugo Joom yimɓe,( 2 )   Laamɗo yimɓe.( 3 )   Dewum yimɓe,( 4 )   bonan wispitoowo wurtinoowo -( 5 )   ngon wispito [bonan] nder ɓerɗe yimɓe -( 6 )   jinn e yimɓe.
76.instruction: Rewti janngu [Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)], [Soorah al-Falaq (113)] e [Soorah an-Naas (114)]

77.translation: 'Amin subi, wakkati ngoo laamu fow ko Alla, tanore fow ko Alla. Alaa dewum so Alla, gooto, alaa hawtudo, O ndan laamu fow e tanore, O waawi fow. Joom am, miɗo ɗagoraa moƴƴum ñalnde ndee e moƴƴum ko ɓaawo mum, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan ñalnde ndee e bonan ko ɓaawo mum. Joom am, miɗo yaha kaldugo e haŋkare e mawniiki. Joom am, miɗo yaha kaldugo e jaɓɓorgol Jasiika e jaɓɓorgol kaburu.'
77.instruction: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’…likewise, one says in the morning:Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah….‘We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty…’

78.translation: (Alla, e yaynnde Ma amin subi e yaynnde Ma amin ɗikiri, e yaynnde Ma amin nguri e maaye, to O nguri en.)[Ñikira:] (Alla, e yaynnde Ma amin ɗikiri e yaynnde Ma amin subi, e yaynnde Ma amin nguri e maaye, to O hootirde en.)
78.instruction: (Allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna, wabika nahya ,wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.)[Ñikira:] (Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.)

79.translation: (Alla, Ako Joom am, alaa dewum so A, A tagi mi, miɗo golloowo Ma, miɗo diidi ka Ma e jaggol Ma no mi waawi, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan ko mi waɗi. Miɗo jaɓa niima Ma am, miɗo jaɓa hakkeeji am, Yaaf mi, tigi alaa moya yaaf hakkeeji so A.)
79.instruction: (Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.)

80.translation: (Alla, tigi mi subi, miɗo nodda A, jaayɓe jaaɓɗe Ma, malaa'ika Ma, e fow tagi Ma seere: A ko Alla, alaa dewum so A, gooto, alaa hawtudo, Muhammad ko golloowo Ma e Nelaaɗo Ma.) (nayi subaka e ɗikira)(Tesko: ɗikira, neɗɗo jannga (amsaytu) ɓaawo (asbahtu).)
80.instruction: (Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduk, wa-oshhidu hamalata AAarshik, wamala-ikatak, wajameeAAa khalqik, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluk .) (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu) instead of (asbahtu).)

81.translation: (Alla, niima kala mi subi walla hay gooto e tagi Ma, ko Ma gooto, alaa hawtudo, to Ma tanore fow to Ma jettoode fow.)(...moya wiyi ngoo subaka o hokkani jettoode ñalnde mum, moya wiyi ngoo ɗikira o hokkani jettoode jamma mum.)(Tesko: ɗikira, neɗɗo jannga (amsa) ɓaawo (asbaha).)
81.instruction: (Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.)(Tesko: ɗikira, neɗɗo jannga (amsa) ɓaawo (asbaha).)

82.translation: (Alla, hokku ɓandu am weltal, Alla, hokku nanngo am weltal, Alla, hokku gite am weltal. Alaa dewum so A.)(sabo) (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e kufr e yonta, miɗo yaha kaldugo e jaɓɓorgol kaburu. Alaa dewum so A. (sabo))
82.instruction: (Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant.(three times).)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant (three times).)

83.translation: Alla yottaani mi, alaa dewum so O, e O miɗo jokkonda, O ko Joom jaaɓɗe mawnde.' (Janngu jeeɗiɗi e arab.)
83.instruction: (Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem (Janngu jeeɗiɗi e arab.)

84.translation: Alla, miɗo ɗagoraa yaafre e weltal nder nguurndam ngam e ɓaawo. Alla, miɗo ɗagoraa yaafre e weltal nder diine am e dunya am, e yimɓe am e jawdi am. Alla, suuɗaa ɗaali am, weltina hulɓinle am. Alla, toppita mi yeeso e ɓaawo e nano e nano e dow, miɗo yaha kaldugo nde leydi liɓa mi.
84.instruction: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee.

85.translation: (Alla, Annduɗo geese e gonɗe, Taguɗo kule e leydi, Joom e Laamɗo fow, miɗo seedee alaa dewum so A. Miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan neɗɗaagal am e bonan e shirk seytaane, e waɗde bonede neɗɗaagal am walla waddude ngol e muslim goɗɗo.)(shirk: hawtude yimɓe goɗɓe e Alla nder ko woni O mum. Ngol waawi (1) goonga, hono goonguɗe non-Alla waawi nafaa walla bonaade, (2) wolde, hono walliɗe non-Alla (3) golle, hono suujudde non-Alla.)
85.instruction: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

86.translation: (E innde Alla, innde nde hay huunde heɓataa leydi walla kule, O ko Nannoowo, Anndoowo fow.'(sabo))
86.instruction: (Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem. (sabo).

87.translation: (Miɗo jaɓi Alla Joom, Islam diine e Muhammad Nelaaɗo.'(sabo))
87.instruction: (Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin  nabiyya. (sabo))

88.translation: (E Gonɗo nguurndam, e Jokkiɗo fow, e yiurnde Ma miɗo ndaɓa wallit, feewna ko kala am, a wattin mi neɗɗaagal am, hata reew gite.)
88.instruction: (Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn.)

89.translation: (Amin subi, wakkati ngoo laamu fow ko Alla, Joom aduna. Alla, miɗo ɗagoraa moƴƴum ñalnde ndee, taalooji mum e keɓgol mum, lewlew mum e barkeeji mum e ndeewtal mum, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan ñalnde ndee e bonan ko ɓaawo mum.)[Ñikira, ɗu'a janngaa hono:] (Amin ɗikiri, wakkati ngoo laamu fow ko Alla, Joom aduna. Alla, miɗo ɗagoraa moƴƴum jamma njam, taalooji mum e keɓgol mum, lewlew mum e barkeeji mum e ndeewtal mum, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan jamma njam e bonan ko ɓaawo mum.)
89.instruction: (Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: ](Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha washarri ma baAAdaha.)

90.translation: (Amin subi dow fitrah Islam, e wolde goonga, e dow diine Nelaaɗo en Muhammad e diine mawniraaɗo en Ibraheem, gonɗo muslim e goonga, o wonaani e ɓe hawtortoo yimɓe goɗɓe e Alla.)(fitrah: diine Islam, laawol Ibraheem.)(Tesko: ɗikira, neɗɗo jannga amsayna ɓaawo asbahna.)
90.instruction: (Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad  waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.)(Tesko: ɗikira, neɗɗo jannga amsayna ɓaawo asbahna.)

92.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, gooto, alaa hawtudo, O ndan laamu fow e tanore, O waawi fow.)( [sappo walla gooto so haŋkare])
92.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.  [sappo walla gooto so haŋkare])

93.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, gooto, alaa hawtudo, O ndan laamu fow e tanore, O waawi fow.)((teemedde ñalnde kala))
93.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer. (teemedde ñalnde kala))

94.translation: (Alla feewni, miɗo tanore O limoore tagi O e jaɓgol O, e teddungal jaaɓɗe O e taniinde wolde O.)(sabo)
94.instruction: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih.)(sabo)

95.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗagoraa ganndal nafuɗo e rizqi moƴƴo e golle jaɓaaɗe.)
95.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.)

96.translation: 'Miɗo ɗagoraa Alla yaafre, miɗo hoota O e tuba.' [teemedde ñalnde kala]

97.translation: (Miɗo yaha kaldugo e wolde Alla timmuɗe e bonan ko O tagi.)(sabo ɗikira)
97.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.) (sabo ɗikira)

98.translation: 'Alla, nelaa e daraja e hokka salaat e saliima dow Nelaaɗo en Muhammad.' [sappo]
98.instruction: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin[sappo]

99.translation: (Nde Nelaaɗo yaha leeso jamma kala, o hawta junngi mum, o tuffa (tuffagol ko ɓurngo huunde e tuffe seeda) nder maɓɓe, o jannga tati cappanɗe cakkitiiɗe (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) Kur'aana, o yeela ɓandu mum fow no waawi e junngi mum, o fuɗɗa hoore e yeeso o fow taƴe ɓandu, o waɗa ngol sabo.)

100.translation: Alla - alaa dewum so O, Gonɗo nguurndam, Jokkiɗo [fow] ngonka. Ɓurnduki walla pillaaki heɓataa O. O ndan ko woni kule e ko woni leydi. Moye waawota yeewtude e O so yaynnde O? O anndi ko woni yeeso maɓɓe e ko ɓaawo maɓɓe, ɓe kaƴƴitaani hay huunde e ganndal O so ko O yiɗi. Kursi O yaajni kule e leydi, toppitaago ɗi mettataa O. O ko Toowɗo, Mawɗo.

102.translation: (E innde Ma Joom am, miɗo yaha, e innde Ma miɗo ummoo, so A jigini neɗɗaagal am Yurma a, so A wurtini a toppita a no A toppitortoo gollooɓe Ma goonga.)
102.instruction: (Bismika rabbee wadaAAtu janbee wabika arfaAAuh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfathha bima tahfathu bihi AAibadakas-saliheen.)

103.translation: (Alla, tigi A tagi neɗɗaagal am, A ɓesaa a, Ma ko nguurndam e maayde mum. So A wuurtini neɗɗaagal am toppita a, so A ɓesi a yaaf a. Alla, miɗo ɗagoraa weltal.)
103.instruction: (Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfathha, wa-in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafiyah.)

104.translation: (Alla, toppita mi e jaɓɓorgol Ma ñalnde gollooɓe Ma ummitee.)

105.translation: (E innde Ma Alla, miɗo maaya e nguurndam.)

106.translation: (Alla feewni. (cappanɗe tati e tati) Tanore fow ko Alla. (cappanɗe tati e tati) Alla mawɗo. (cappanɗe tati e nayi))
106.instruction: (Subhanal-lah. (thirty-three times) Alhamdu lillah. (thirty-three times) Allahu akbar. (thirty-four times))

107.translation: (Alla, Joom kule jeeɗiɗi e jaaɓɗe mawnde, Joom en e Joom fow, Feccitooɗo ɓiŋŋe e ñaŋŋaŋde koyne, Ummiinoowo Tawrah, Injeel e Furqan, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan fow ko A jowa yeeso (o woni A jogii laamu fow dow mum). Alla, A ko Fuɗɗo, alaa hay huunde yeeso Ma, A ko Cakkitiiɗo, alaa hay huunde ɓaawo Ma. A ko Aththahir, alaa hay huunde dow Ma, A ko Al-Batin, alaa hay huunde ɓadiiɗo Ma. Yoɓa jaaɓɗe en, reen en e yonta.)(Tawrah: defteere ummiinde Moosa.)(Injeel: defteere ummiinde Easa.)(Furqan: gooto e inɗe Kur'aana, kɔrɔ: Feccitooɗo hakkunde goonga e fewre.)(Aththahir: jiraa mawneeki jiraw O e seedantaagal tagi kala hakkunde mawneeki O e Toowna O, O ko dow tagi O fow hoore mum e jiraw.)(Al-Batin: jiraa anndal O e ganndal O geese fow, ko woni nder ɓerɗe e ko ɓuri suuɗde, no jiraa ɓadaare O e ɓadiide O fow cogo moƴƴo laamu O.)
107.instruction: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA, warabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, aAAoothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa baAAdaka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi AAannad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr.)

108.translation: (Tanore fow ko Alla, ngu ñaami en e wari en, ngu yottini en e ñuuri en, ko woni ɗuuɗɓe alaa mo yottina ɓe walla ñuura ɓe.)
108.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wee.)

109.translation: (Alla, Annduɗo geese e gonɗe, Taguɗo kule e leydi, Joom e Laamɗo fow, miɗo seedee alaa dewum so A. Miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan neɗɗaagal am e bonan e shirk seytaane, e waɗde bonede neɗɗaagal am walla waddude ngol e muslim goɗɗo.)(shirk: hawtude yimɓe goɗɓe e Alla nder ko woni O mum. Ngol waawi (1) goonga, hono goonguɗe non-Alla waawi nafaa walla bonaade, (2) wolde, hono walliɗe non-Alla (3) golle, hono suujudde non-Alla.)
109.instruction: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, wa-an aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

110.translation: (Nelaaɗo pillaaki haa o janngi Soorat As-Sajdah (surat 32) e Soorat Al-Mulk (surat 67).)

111.translation: (Alla, miɗo hokki neɗɗaagal am to A, miɗo laatani A ko kala am, miɗo ƴettidi yeeso am to A, miɗo jokkonda fow e A, e yiɗde e hulɓinde A. Tigi alaa ndaɓli walla wurtorde e A so to A. Miɗo goongi e Defteere Ma nde A ummiini e Nelaaɗo Ma mo A neli.)(So a maayi, a maaya dow fitrah.)(fitrah: diine Islam, laawol Ibraheem.)
111.instruction: (Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa-alja/tu thahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wala manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wabinabiyyikal-lathee arsalt.)

1.translation: (Tanore fow ko Alla ngu hokki en nguurndam ɓaawo o ɓesi en, to O ummital.)
1.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.)

2.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, gooto alaa hawtudo, O ndan laamu e tanore, O waawi fow haa timmu. Alla feewni, tanore fow ko Alla, alaa dewum so Alla, Alla mawɗo, alaa sekaa walla fange so Alla, Toowɗo, Mawɗo. Joom am, yaaf mi)
2.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala  ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAaliyyil AAatheem. Rabbigh-fir lee)

3.translation: (Tanore fow ko Alla ngu wuttini weltal am e wuttini neɗɗaagal am e yaynni mi miɗo siftina O.)
3.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee fee jasadee waradda AAalayya roohee wa-athina lee bithikrih.)

4.instruction: Fuɗɗo Aaya 3:190 haa joofi surat Al-Imran

10.translation: ((E innde Alla). Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan fow e bonankooɓe.)
10.instruction: ((Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.)

13.translation: (Miɗo seedee alaa dewum so Alla, gooto alaa hawtudo, miɗo seedee Muhammad ko golloowo O e Nelaaɗo O.)
13.instruction: (Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh.)

14.translation: (Alla, waɗ mi e ɓe hootortoo to A tuba no feewi, waɗ mi e ɓe ngoni feewɓe e laaɓɓe.)

15.translation: (A feewni Alla, miɗo tanore A, miɗo seedee alaa dewum so A, miɗo ɗagoraa yaafre Ma, miɗo tuba to A.)
15.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

16.translation: (E innde Alla, miɗo jokkonda e Alla, alaa sekaa walla fange so Alla.)
16.instruction: (Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu AAalal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

17.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo nde mi majjinaa walla majjine, walla mi leeya walla leeyine, walla mi tooña walla tooñe, walla mi huuwa walla huuwe.)(leeya: ko woni waɗde hakkee tijaani)
17.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay.)

18.translation: (E innde Alla amin naati, e innde Alla amin ummi, e Joom en amin jokkondiri.)
18.instruction: (Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna.)

19.translation: ('Alla, waɗ nder ɓernde am lewlew; e dow ɗemngal am lewlew; e nder noppi am lewlew; e nder gite am lewlew; waɗ dow am lewlew; les am lewlew; nano am lewlew; nano am lewlew; yeeso am lewlew; ɓaawo am lewlew; waɗ nder neɗɗaagal am lewlew; ɓeyda lewle am; mawnina lewle am; hokku mi lewle waɗ mi lewle. Alla, hokka mi lewle; waɗ lewle nder ƴoole am; lewle nder ɓeydu am; lewle nder ƴiiƴam am; lewle nder gaske am e lewle nder ɗaagal am.' [Alla, waɗ lewle am nder kaburu am e lewle nder ƴiye am]. [Ɓeyda mi e lewle, ɓeyda mi e lewle, ɓeyda mi e lewle]. [Hokku mi lewle dow lewle.]')
19.instruction: Allaahummaj 'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran. Wa j'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran. Waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran. Allaahumma a'tineje nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wa fee lahmee nooran, wa fee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.[Allaahummaj'al lee nooran fee qabree, wa nooran fee 'idhaamee.][Wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran.][Wa hab lee nooran 'alaa noor.]

20.translation: (Miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla, Mawɗo e Yeeso O teddungal e laamu O duuɓiɗo e seytaane riñaaɗo. E innde Alla, salaat e saliima dow Nelaaɗo Alla. Alla, uddit dammbugal yiurnde Ma am.)
20.instruction: (aAAoothu billahil-AAatheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, [bismil-lah, wassalatu] [wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah] , allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik.)

21.translation: (E innde Alla, salaat e saliima dow Nelaaɗo Alla. Alla, miɗo ɗagoraa niima Ma. Alla, reen mi e seytaane riñaaɗo.)
21.instruction: (Bismil-lah wassalatu wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah, allahumma innee as-aluka min fadlik, allahumma iAAsimnee minash-shaytanir-rajeem.)

22.translation: 'Neɗɗo repeta no mu-aththin (noddoowo salaat) wiyata, so wonaa nde o wiyi: Hayya AAalas-salah (walla) hayya AAalal-falah 'waro salaat, waro keɓgol' ɓaawo, neɗɗo foti wiyde: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah. 'Alaa sekaa walla fange so Alla.'

23.translation: Reew ɓaawo goonga wiyaaɗo mu-aththin, neɗɗo wiya:'Mi kadi seedee alaa dewum so Alla, gooto, alaa hawtudo, Muhammad ko golloowo O e Nelaaɗo O. Miɗo jaɓi Alla Joom, Muhammad Nelaaɗo e Islam diine.'
23.instruction: Reew ɓaawo goonga wiyaaɗo mu-aththin, neɗɗo wiya:Wa-ana ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh, radeetu billahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasoolan wabil-islami deena.

24.translation: 'Neɗɗo foti nelde salaat dow Nelaaɗo (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) ɓaawo jaabawol noddaango mu.adhdhin'.

25.translation: 'Alla, Joom noddaango timmuɗo ngoo e Joom salaat ngoo waɗeteengol, hokku Muhammad al-waseelah e al-fadeelah, ummiɗɗa o nokku tanoraangu ngon A jaggol o. Tigi A hooltataa jaggol.'al-waseelah: nokku nder Aljanna.al-fadeelah: daraja dow tagi goɗɗi.tanoraangu nokku: nokku mo tagi fow tanoreto o, ngam waddude jattooɗe yaawde e wurtinde e darondirde juutnde walla daraja yeewtango.
25.instruction: Allahumma rabba hathihid-daAAwatit-tammah, wassalatil-qa-imah ati Muhammadan alwaseelata wal-fadeelah, wabAAath-hu maqaman mahmoodan allathee waAAadtah, innaka la tukhliful-meeAAad.

26.translation: Neɗɗo foti kadi ɗu'a hoore mum wakkati hakkunde athan e iqamah, ɗu'a wakkati ngoo jaɓaake.

5.translation: (Tanore fow ko Alla ngu waɗi mi gerte ngoo e hokki mi nde, alaa sekaa walla fange am.)
5.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee kasanee hatha (aththawb) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

6.translation: (Alla, Ma ko tanore fow, A waɗi mi nde (gerte), miɗo ɗagoraa moƴƴum mum e moƴƴum ko waɗaa ngam, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan mum e bonan ko waɗaa ngam.)
6.instruction: (Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneeh, as-aluka min khayrihi wakhayri ma suniAAa lah, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharrihi washarri ma suniAAa lah.)

7.translation: (A ɓuuɓa nde, Alla ta'aala lomta nde (goɗɗe).' Kɔrɔ: ɗu'a nguurndam juutndam.)

8.translation: (Ɓuuɓa kesi, nguura tanore, maaya shaheed.)(shaheed: Neɗɗo maayooɗo hare kuffar ngam wolde Alla toowna walla reende Islam. Ina waɗi kadi kɔrɔji goɗɗi nder Sunnah hono: neɗɗo maayooɗo reende nguurndam mum, jawdi mum walla yimɓe mum; debbo maayooɗo jibinannde; neɗɗo liɓa...e goɗɗum.)

27.translation: (Alla, wuurtin mi hakkeeji am no A wuurtini Fuɗɗiirde e Hiirnaange, Alla, laaɓin mi hakkeeji am no gerte ɗaneeɗe laaɓetee ɗaasunde, Alla, loota mi hakkeeji am e ɲɩynde, ndiyam e muri.)
27.instruction: (Allahumma baAAid baynee wabayna khatayaya kama baAAadta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, allahumma naqqinee min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allahummagh-silnee min khatayaya biththalji walma/i walbarad.)

28.translation: (A feewni Alla, miɗo tanore A. Barkin innde Ma, toowni daraja Ma, alaa dewum so A.)
28.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika watabarakas-muka wataAAala jadduka wala ilaha ghayruk.)

29.translation: (Miɗo ƴettidi yeeso am goonga to O taguɗo kule e leydi, mi wonaani e ɓe hawtortoo (yimɓe e Alla). Tigi salaat am, korrital am, nguurndam am e maayde am ko Alla, Joom adunaaji, alaa hawtudo O, e ngoo mi yamira, miɗo e muslimɓe. Alla, A ko Laamɗo, alaa dewum so A. A ko Joom am, miɗo golloowo Ma, mi boni neɗɗaagal am, mi jaɓi hakkeeji am, Yaaf mi hakkeeji am fow alaa moya yaaf hakkeeji so A. Fewin mi ɓurɗum ɗaali, alaa mo fewina ɗum so A, wurtin mi ɓurɗum bonde ɗaali, alaa mo wurtina mi ɗum so A. Miɗo ɗoo, jaabawol noddaango Ma, welbittaare gollude A. Moƴƴum fow woni junngi Ma, bonan ummataako to A. Mi woni e feere Ma, mi hoota to A. Barkinɗe e Toownɗe A, miɗo ɗagoraa yaafre Ma, miɗo tuba to A.)(Alla tagataa bonan laaɓɓan ngon alaa moƴƴum walla nafa, hikima walla yiurnde, O jaɓɓortaaka hay neɗɗo so waɗaani hakkee. Huunde waawi moƴƴude tagi mum nde yiyaa e fannu, kadi bonaade nde yiyaa e fannu goɗɗo. Alla tagi seytaane, e mum O ƴeewna gollooɓe O, woni ɓe korɗa seytaane, pono o e laawol mum, ɓe darondiri e o e jooɗɓe mum, woni goɗɓe jokkondirɓe e seytaane, jokkooɓe gawle mum. Bonan ngoni nder tagi O e feere O e hikima O, wonaa nder golle O walla tagu O.)
29.instruction: (Wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefan wama ana minal-mushrikeen, inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, la shareeka lahu wabithalika omirtu wa-ana minal-muslimeen. Allahumma antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant. anta rabbee wa-ana AAabduk, thalamtu nafsee waAAtaraftu bithanbee faghfir lee thunoobee jameeAAan innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdee li-ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif AAannee sayyi-aha la yasrifu AAannee sayyi-aha illa ant, labbayka wasaAAdayk,walkhayru kulluhu biyadayk, washsharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa-ilayk, tabarakta wataAAalayt, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

30.translation: (Alla, Joom Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel e Israfeel (malaa'ika mawɓe), Taguɗo kule e leydi, Annduɗo gonɗe e geese. A ko sarotoowo hakkunde gollooɓe Ma nder ko ɓe tefdi. Fewin mi goonga e yaynnde Ma, nder ko ɓe tefdi, tigi A fewinoo mo A yiɗi laawol jaajngol.)
30.instruction: (Allahumma rabba jibra-eel, wameeka-eel, wa-israfeel fatiras-samawati walard, AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-ithnik, innaka tahdee man tasha-o ila siratin mustaqeem.)

31.translation: (Alla mawɗo mawɗo, Alla mawɗo mawɗo, Alla mawɗo mawɗo, tanore ɗuuɗɗe ko Alla, tanore ɗuuɗɗe ko Alla, tanore ɗuuɗɗe ko Alla, miɗo wiyaa feewugol Alla subaka e ɗikira.)(Miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla e seytaane, e mawninal mum, jimɗi mum e wuluugol mum.)
31.instruction: (Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, wasubhanal-lahi bukratan wa-aseela.)(aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytani min nafkhihi wanafthihi wahamzih.)

32.translation: (Alla, Ma ko tanore fow, A ko Lewlew kule e leydi e fow woni nder maɓɓe. Ma ko tanore fow, A ko Jokkiɗo kule e leydi e fow woni nder maɓɓe. Ma ko tanore fow. A ko Joom kule e leydi e fow woni nder maɓɓe. Ma ko tanore fow e laamu kule e leydi e fow woni nder maɓɓe. Ma ko tanore fow, A ko Laamɗo kule e leydi, Ma ko tanore fow. A ko Goonga, jaggol Ma goonga, Wolde Ma goonga, Ñalnde amin nodda e A goonga, Aljanna goonga, Jasiika goonga, Nelaaɓe goonga, Muhammad goonga, Wakkati cakkitiingol goonga. Alla, to A mi laatani, dow A mi jokkondiri, e A mi goongi, to A mi tubi, e A mi tefi, to A mi ɓaɓɓiri sariya. Yaaf mi ko kɛni e hakkeeji am e ko arata, ko mi suuɗi e ko mi bayyini. A ko Al-Muqaddim e Al-Mu-akhkhir. Alaa dewum so A, A ko Dewum am, alaa dewum so A.)(Kɔrɔ Al-Muqaddim e Al-Mu-akhkhir: Alla ɓaɓɓoo yeeso e maɓɓina mo O yiɗi e tagi O no O yoɓɓoo ɓaawo e darjoo mo O yiɗi e hikima O. Hono maɓɓinde neɗɗo dow tagi goɗɗi, maɓɓinde Nelaaɓe dow yimɓe goɗɓe, maɓɓinde Muhammad dow Nelaaɓe e Nelaaɓe fow...e goɗɗum.)
32.instruction: (Allahumma lakal-hamd anta noorus-samawati wal-ardi waman feehin, walakal-hamd, anta qayyimus-samawati walardi waman feehin, [walakal-hamd, anta rabbus-samawati walardi waman feehin], [walakal-hamd, laka mulkus-samawati walardi waman feehin] [walakal-hamd, anta malikus-samawati walard] [walakal-hamd] [antal-haq, wawaAAdukal-haq, waqawlukal-haq, waliqa-okal-haq, waljannatu haq wannaru haq, wannabiyyoona haq, wa Muhammadun  haq, wassaAAatu haq] [allahumma laka aslamt, waAAalayka tawakkalt, wabika amant, wa-ilayka anabt, wabika khasamt, wa-ilayka hakamt, faghfir lee ma qaddamt, wama akhkhart, wama asrart, wama aAAlant] [antal-muqaddim, wa-antal-mu-akhkhir, la ilaha illa ant] [anta ilahee la ilaha illa ant .)

34.translation: (A feewni Alla, Joom en, miɗo tanore A. Alla, yaaf mi.)

35.translation: (Feewɗo e Laamɗo (O), Joom malaa'ika e Rooh (o woni Jibra-eel).)

36.translation: (Alla, to A mi ñuuki, e A mi goongi, to A mi laatani. Nanngo am, gite am, hakkiilo am, ƴiye am, ƴoole am e ko koyngi am ɓaɓɓoo humbiiɗi yeeso Ma.)
36.instruction: (Allahumma laka rakaAAt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, khashaAAa laka samAAee, wabasaree, wamukhkhee, waAAathmee, waAAasabee, wamas-taqalla bihi qadamee.)

37.translation: (Feewɗo O, Jogiiɗo fange fow, laamu, mawnal e teddungal.)

38.translation: (Alla jaaba mo tanori O.)(Ɗu'a ngoo waɗetee nde neɗɗo ummotoo.)

39.translation: (Joom en, Ma ko tanore fow, tanore ɗuuɗɗe, moƴƴe, barkinɗe.)
39.instruction: (Rabbana walakal-hamdu hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh.)

40.translation: (Kule e leydi e fow hakkunde maɓɓe heewi tanore Ma, fow ko A yiɗi heewi tanore Ma. E Jogiiɗo tanore e teddungal, ɓurngo goonga ko golloowo wiyi (e Ma), amin fow ko gollooɓe Ma. Alla, alaa daaɗtoowo ko A yiɗi hokkude, alaa hokkowoowo ko A yiɗi daaɗde, alaa jawdi walla teddungal nafa hay neɗɗo, ko Ma fow...)
40.instruction: (Mil-as-samawati wamil-al-ard, wama baynahuma, wamil/a ma shi/ta min shay-in baAAd, ahlath-thana-i walmajd, ahaqqu ma qalal-AAabd, wakulluna laka AAabd. Allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad.)

42.translation: (A feewni Alla, Joom en, miɗo tanore A. Alla, yaaf mi.)

43.translation: (Feewɗo e Laamɗo (O), Joom malaa'ika e Rooh (o woni Jibra-eel).)

44.translation: (Alla, to A mi suujudi, e A mi goongi, to A mi laatani. Yeeso am suujudi yeeso O taguɗo ɗum e feewnuɗo ɗum, ummiinuɗo nanngo e gite mum. Alla barkinɗe, Ɓurɗo taguɓe.)
44.instruction: (Allahumma laka sajadt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu wasawwarahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu, tabarakal-lahu ahsanul-khaliqeen.)

45.translation: (Feewɗo O, Jogiiɗo fange fow, laamu, mawnal e teddungal.)

46.translation: (Alla, yaaf mi hakkeeji am fow, seedi e mawɗi, fuɗɗi e cakkitiiɗi, gonɗi e suuɗaaɗi.)
46.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee thanbee kullah, diqqahu wajillah, wa-awwalahu wa-akhirah, wa- AAalaniyyatahu wa-sirrah.)

47.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo nder jaɓgol Ma e mettugol Ma, nder yaafre Ma e jaɓɓorgol Ma, miɗo yaha kaldugo e A e A. Mi waawaaye limde tanore Ma, A ko no A tanori hoore Ma.)
47.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wa-bimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik.)

48.translation: (Joom am yaaf mi, Joom am yaaf mi.)

49.translation: (Alla, yaaf mi, yurma mi, fewin mi, feewin mi, weltina mi, riziqi mi, toowna daraja am.)
49.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, waAAafinee, warzuqnee warfaAAnee.)

50.translation: (Yeeso am suujudi yeeso O taguɗo ɗum, ummiinuɗo nanngo e gite mum e sekaa O e fange O.<< Alla barkinɗe, ɓurɗo taguɓe.)
50.instruction: (Sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu bihawlihi waquwwatih  { tabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeen}.)

51.translation: (Alla, winndani mi njoɓdi ngam ngoo (sujuud), ittu e mi hakkee. Moofta nde am, jaɓa nde e mi no A jaɓiri nde e golloowo Ma Dawood.)
51.instruction: (Allahummak-tub lee biha  AAindaka ajra, wadaAA  AAannee biha wizra, wajAAalha lee AAindaka thukhra, wataqabbalha minnee kama taqabbaltaha min AAabdika Dawood.)

52.translation: (At-tahiyyat ko Alla. Golle adaba fow e moƴƴe fow ko O. Salaat e yiurnde e barkeeji Alla dow maɓaa E Nelaaɗo. Salaat dow amin e gollooɓe Alla goonga. Miɗo seedee alaa dewum so Alla, miɗo seedee Muhammad ko golloowo O e Nelaaɗo O.)(At-tahiyyat: wolde fow jirtaaɗe mawninde Alla. Ngonka O duuɓiɗo, feewugol O e laamu O.)
52.instruction: (Attahiyyatu lillahi wassalawatu wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu warahmatul-lahi wabarakatuh, assalamu AAalayna waAAala AAibadil-lahis-saliheen. Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh.)

53.translation: (Alla, nelaa salaat dow Muhammad e jooɗɓe Muhammad, no A nelaani salaat dow Ibraheem e jooɗɓe Ibraheem. Tigi A heewi tanore e teddungal. Alla, barikina Muhammad e yimɓe Muhammad, no A barikini Ibraheem e yimɓe Ibraheem. Tigi A heewi tanore e teddungal.)(nelaa salaat: tanore e toowninde o nder juulde toownde ɓurnde: nde malaa'ika ɓadiiɓe Alla)((al) firtaa e maanaa yaajngal: ganndalɓe wonɓe wiyi maanaa ɗoo ɓuri ƴeewndude: jooɗɓe mum e yimɓe mum.)
53.instruction: (Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed, allahumma barik AAala  Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama barakta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed.)

54.translation: (Alla, nelaa salaat dow Muhammad e debbooji Muhammad e ɓiɓɓe Muhammad, no A nelaani salaat dow yimɓe Ibraheem, barikina Muhammad e debbooji Muhammad e ɓiɓɓe Muhammad, no A barikini yimɓe Ibraheem. Tigi A heewi tanore e teddungal.)
54.instruction: (Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatihi kama sallayta AAala ali Ibraheem, wabarik AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatih, kama barakta AAala ali Ibraheem. innaka Hameedun Majeed.)

55.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e jaɓɓorgol kaburu, e jaɓɓorgol Jasiika, e fitina e ɓaleel nguurndam e maayde e bonan fitina Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal.)(Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal: e maandeeji mawɗi wakkati cakkitiingol e ɓaleelji mawɗi ɓetooji yimɓe, Nelaaɗo kala tintini ɗum. Yimɓe ɗuuɗɓe ɓe mbi'a mum. O feeñata Asbahan, Iran wakkati mo muslimɓe keɓata Constantinople. O hokketee sekaa keeriingu, o waɗata goonga waylu fewre, fewre waylu goonga. O wiyata o goonga, o wiyata o nelaaɗo, o joofi o wiyata o dewum. E maandeeji mum: o doɗa gite nano, ngon ko seereh tiinɗo haɗa jaggol mum dewum, ko maande feewugol. Wolde Kafir winndetee hakkunde gite mum, goonguɗo kala, jannguɗo walla janngaaniɗo, anndinta nde.)(Mo waɗi e sikke sappo fuɗɗeeje Soorat Al-Kahf reentee e Dajjal.)(Neɗɗo foti kadi yaha kaldugo e Alla e ɓaleelji Dajjal ɓaawo tashahhud cakkitiingol nder salaat. (Yeeɓu ɗu'aaji #55 e #56.))
55.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wamin AAathabi jahannam, wamin fitnatil-mahya walmamat, wamin shari fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal.)

56.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e jaɓɓorgol kaburu, miɗo yaha kaldugo e fitina e ɓaleel Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, miɗo yaha kaldugo e fitina e ɓaleel nguurndam e maayde. Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e hakkee e jaaɓɗe.)
56.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-mahya walmamat. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-ma/thami walmaghram.)

57.translation: (Alla, tigi mi tooñi neɗɗaagal am tooñde ɗuuɗɗe, alaa moya yaaf hakkeeji so A, Yaaf mi yaafre to Ma, yurma mi. Tigi A ko Yaafowoowo ɓurɗo, Yiurmoowo ɓurɗo.)(To Ma: ko woni e baabawal Ma alaa min heɓaa, yaafre moƴƴo dibal Ma mawngal.)
57.instruction: (Allahumma innee thalamtu nafsee thulman katheeran wala yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant, faghfir lee maghfiratan min AAindik warhamnee, innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.)

58.translation: (Alla, yaaf mi hakkeeji ɓe kɛni e ɓe arata, ɓe mi waɗi nder suuɗde e ɓe mi bayyini, ɓe mi tiiɗni e ɓe A anndi ɓuri mi. A ko Al-Muqaddim e Al-Mu-akhkhir. Alaa dewum so A.)(Kɔrɔ Al-Muqaddim e Al-Mu-akhkhir: Alla ɓaɓɓoo yeeso e maɓɓina mo O yiɗi, O yoɓɓoo ɓaawo mo O yiɗi e hikima O...)
58.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee ma qaddamtu,  wama akhkhart, wama asrartu wama aAAlant, wama asraftt, wama anta aAAlamu bihi minnee, antal-muqaddimu wa-antal-mu-akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant.)

59.translation: (Alla, walla mi siinude Ma, jettaade Ma, adaba Ma e laawal ɓurngol moƴƴude.)
59.instruction: (Allahumma aAAinnee AAala thikrik, washukrik, wahusni AAibadatik.)

60.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e gonndal e ŋakkaare, miɗo yaha kaldugo yiide wartaade e ɓurngol bonde nguurndam "ko woni mawnugol, leemugol, waawtugol e nder kulle", miɗo yaha kaldugo e fitina e ɓaleel nguurndam ɗam e jaɓɓorgol kaburu.)
60.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-bukhl, wa-aAAoothu bika minal-jubn, wa-aAAoothu bika min an oradda ila arthalil- AAumur, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatid-dunya waAAathabil-qabr.)

61.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma Jannat, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Jasiika.)

62.translation: (Alla, e anndal Ma ɓe suuɗii e sekaa Ma dow taguɓe, hokku mi nguurndam sahaa fow A anndi nguurndam ɗam moƴƴa am, ittu mi so A anndi maayde moƴƴa am. Alla, waɗ mi kulɗo Ma nder suuɗde e peene. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma waɗ mi goonga wolde, e sahaa yidde e e sahaa yanne. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma waɗ mi hakkilanoowo e sahaa jawdi e miskinende. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma weltaare duuɓiinde e sefere nde waktataa abada. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma waɗ mi jaɓɗo ko A sarii e nguurndam yaasnaangam ɓaawo maayde. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma daasugol daade yeeso Ma e muuyde jonkun Ma e laawal ngal ɓesdaa fittaare ngaddaano bonde walla ɓaleel waylaano. Alla, meɓɓina amin e meɓɓal goongɗingal, waɗ amin e ɓe fewina ɓe fewnaa.)
62.instruction: (Allahumma biAAilmikal-ghayb, waqudratika AAalal-khalq, ahyinee ma AAalimtal-hayata khayran lee watawaffanee itha AAalimtal-wafata khayran lee, allahumma innee as-aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi washshahadah, wa-as-aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida walghadab, wa-as-alukal-qasda fil-ghina walfaqr, wa-as-aluka naAAeeman la yanfad, wa-as-aluka qurrata AAaynin la tanqatiAA, wa-as-alukar-rida baAAdal-qada/, wa-as-aluka bardal-AAayshi baAAdal-mawt, wa-as-aluka laththatan-nathari ila wajhik, washshawqa ila liqa-ik fee ghayri darraa mudirrah, wala fitnatin mudillah, allahumma zayyinna bizeenatil-eeman wajAAalna hudatan muhtadeen.)

63.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma E Alla, ko A ko Gooto, Tan, AS-Samad, O jibinaani, O jibinaa kadi, alaa gooto no O, Yaaf mi hakkeeji am tigi A ko Yaafowoowo ɓurɗo, Yiurmoowo ɓurɗo.)(AS-Samad: Joomiɗo hoore mum, Joom halluɗi timmuɗi mo taguɓe fow ndira e ɗum e koɗɗaɗe mum fow.)
63.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka ya Allah bi-annakal-wahidul-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad, walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfira lee thunoobee innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.)

64.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma, tanore fow ko Ma, alaa dewum so A, A gooto, alaa gondiiɗo Ma. A ko Hokkinoowo. E Fuɗɗoowo kammuwe e leydi, E Joom teddungal e daraja, E Nguurɗo abada, E Hoɗɗo e Hoore mum Walliinoowo fow, tigi miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma Jannat, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e Jasiika.)
64.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka bianna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa ant wahdaka la shareeka lak, almannan, ya badeeAAas-samawati wal-ard, ya thal-jalali wal-ikram, ya hayyu ya qayyoom, innee as-alukal-jannah, wa-aAAoothu bika minan-nar.)

65.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma, miɗo seedee A ko Alla, alaa dewum so A, Gooto, AS-Samad O jibinaani, O jibinaa kadi, alaa gooto no O.)(AS-Samad: Joomiɗo hoore mum, Joom halluɗi timmuɗi mo taguɓe fow ndira e ɗum e koɗɗaɗe mum fow.)
65.instruction: (Allahumma inne as-aluka biannee ashhadu annaka antal-lah, la ilaha illa ant, al-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.)

66.translation: (Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Alla yaafre.(wolde tati) (Alla, A ko As-Salam, jam fow ummoraade e Ma, A barkinɗe, E Joom teddungal e daraja.) (As-Salam: O meeñaano e caale fow e ŋakkeende fow.))
66.instruction: (Astaghfirul-lah (three times) (Allahumma antas-salam waminkas-salam, tabarakta ya thal-jalali wal-ikram.))

67.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O, O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde. Alla, alaa haɗoo ko A yoɓi hokkude, alaa hokkoo ko A yoɓi haɗude, jawdi walla daraja naftaa hay gooto, sabu jawdi e daraja fow ko Ma.)
67.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad.)

68.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O, O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde. Alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla, alaa dewum so Alla, min adaba hay gooto so O. Ma ko moƴƴere fow, baabawal fow e tanore teddungal. Alaa dewum so Alla, min ngoni goonga e goongɗingal e jokku e O hay so ngoɗɗuɓe yiɗaa ɗum.)
68.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer. la hawla wala quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illal-lah, wala naAAbudu illa iyyah, lahun-niAAmatu walahul-fadl walahuth-thana-ol- hasan, la ilaha illal-lah mukhliseena lahud-deen walaw karihal-kafiroon.)

69.translation: (Alla meeñaani, tanore fow ko Alla, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude.(wolde cappande tati e tati) (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O, O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde.))
69.instruction: (Subhanal-lah walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar (thirty-three times). (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.))

70.translation: Soorah tati ɗee tawetee wolde gooto ɓaawo salaat Zuhr, 'Asr e 'Ishaa, wolde tati ɓaawo salaat Fajr e Maghrib.[Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)] [Soorah al-Falaq (113)] [Soorah an-Naas (114)]

71.translation: Ko e Sunnah kadi tawde Aayat ul-Kursee ɓaawo salaat kala:[Soorah al-Baqarah, Aayah 255]

72.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O, O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow, O hokkoo nguurndam O hokkoo maayde, O sekaa dow kala huunde.(wolde sappo ɓaawo salaat Maghrib e Fajr))
72.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeet, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.(ten times after the maghrib & fajr prayers))

73.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma anndal nafaal, riziqi moƴƴo, e golle jaɓɓaali.)(Wiyetee ɓaawo hokkude salaam salaat Fajr)
73.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.(after salam from fajr prayer))

74.translation: (E barkewal Jabir Ibn AAabdullah, o wiyi: 'Nelaaɗo ɗon fàtta amin ɗuɓɓude fewindugol e koɗɗaɗe amin fow, no o fàttirta amin Soorah e Kuraan. O wiyata: 'So gooto maɓɓe yiɗi fuɗɗude koɗɗal, o salaa ɗiɗi rakAAah ɓe ɓeydii (ñaari rakaa naafila) ɓaawo ɗum o ɗuɓɓoo:'Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo fewindal Ma e anndal Ma, e sekaa Ma miɗo ɗuɓɓoo fange, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma e moƴƴere Ma mawnde, tigi A waawi, mi waawaa, tigi A anndi, mi anndaa, A ko Anndoowo ɓe suuɗii. Alla, so A anndi koɗɗal ka - e ɗoo o haala koɗɗal mum - moƴƴa am e goongɗingal am, e nguurndam am e cakkitiiɗum am, sariinaa mi ɗum, yaasna mi ɗum, barikina mi e ɗum, so A anndi koɗɗal ka bona am e goongɗingal am, e nguurndam am e cakkitiiɗum am, ittu ɗum e mi, ittu mi e ɗum, sariinaa mi ko moƴƴi ɗo ɗum woni, waɗ mi jaɓɗo ɗum.)(Mo ɗuɓɓi fewindal e Taguɗo mum, waɗi tintinde e goongɗuɓe gondiiɓe, deendi e miijooji mum, haɗaa bakkuɗe, sabu Alla wiyi:...waɗ tintinde e ɓe nder koɗɗal. So A yoɓi miijoo, yaha kaldugo e Alla...)

112.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, Gooto, AL-Qahhar. Joom kammuwe e leydi e ko hakkunde ɗi, Tiiɗɗo daraja, Yaafowoowo ɓurɗo.)(AL-Qahhar: O jaɓɓinɗo taguɓe fow, taguɓe fow jokkuɓe e O. Ndirgol fow ko e yiɗde O.)
112.instruction: La ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wama baynahuma, alAAazeezul-ghaffar.

113.translation: (Miɗo yaha kaldugo e wolde Alla timmuɗe e yanne O e jaɓɓorgol O, e bonan gollooɓe O, e welwelo e feeñde seytaanɓe.)
113.instruction: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih,waAAiqabih, washarri AAibadih, wamin hamazatish-shayateen, wa-an yahduroon.

114.translation: [((Fuu e nano càmman tati)(Fuu: fuugol ko ɓuri yem e ndokku tutti)) - (Ɗuɓɓu kaldugo e Alla e seytaan e bonan ko A yeewi (tati)) - (Wata A haalana hay gooto) - (Yeelitoo, fonndee e wakkere goɗɗo ɓurɗo A fonndani.) - (Ummu salaa so A yiɗi.) ]

116.translation: (Alla, fewin mi e ɓe A fewini, yaaf mi e ɓe A yaafi, won gondiiɗo am e ɓe A gondiiɗo ɓe, barikina mi ko A hokki. Reen mi e bonan ko A sarii tigi A sariyoo, alaa sariyoo dow Ma. Tigi mo A gondiiɗo mum tooɓɗeteeɗaa, mo A haɗɗiiɗo mum teddinteeɗaa. E Joomiɗo amin, A barkinɗe A toownɗe.)(Bonan ko A sarii: Alla tagaa bonde laaɓnde nde alaa moƴƴe walla nafa, hikima walla yiurnde nder mum, O jaɓɓiraa hay gooto alaa o waɗi hakkee. Huunde waawi wonde moƴƴe e tagugol mum so ɗum yeewaa e laawal goɗɗal, e bonde so ɗum yeewaa e laawal goɗɗal. Alla tagi seytaan, e mum O ɓaleloo gollooɓe O, wonɓe ɓe yiɗaa seytaan, Ɠeɓoo e mum e laawal mum, ngoni ginoowo e mum e jooɗɓe mum, wonɓe goɗɓe gondiiɓe e seytaan jokkuɓe jinkuuji mum. Bonde woodi e taguɓe O e yiɗde e hikima O, alaa e golle O walla tagugol O.)
116.instruction: (Allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt, waAAafinee feeman AAafayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabarik lee feema aAAtayt, waqinee sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdee wala yuqda AAalayk, innahu la yathillu man walayt, [wala yaAAizzu man AAadayt], tabarakta rabbana wataAAalayt.)

117.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo nder jaɓɗe Ma e yanne Ma, nder yaafre Ma e jaɓɓorgol Ma, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e Ma. Mi waawaa limde tanore Ma. A woni no A tantani Hoore Ma.)
117.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wabimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik.)

118.translation: (Alla, A min adaba, Ma min salaa min suujuda, Ma min yaara min gollina. Min njɓattoo yiurnde Ma, min ngula jaɓɓorgol Ma, tigi jaɓɓorgol Ma falat dow ngoɗɗuɓe. Alla, min ɗuɓɓoo ballal Ma, min ɗuɓɓoo yaafre Ma, min tantana Ma e moƴƴe fow, min ngoɗɗaa e Ma. Min ngoɗɗi e Ma, min jokki e Ma, min ndillii min ngoɗɗi ɓe ngoɗɗaɓe e Ma.)
118.instruction: (Allahumma iyyaka naAAbud, walaka nusallee wanasjud, wa-ilayka nasAAa wanahfid, narjoo rahmatak, wanakhsha AAathabak, inna AAathabaka bilkafireena mulhaq. Allahumma inna nastaAAeenuk, wanastaghfiruk, wanuthnee AAalaykal- khayr, wala nakfuruk, wanu/minu bik, wanakhdaAAu lak wanakhlaAAu man yakfuruk.)

119.translation: (Laamɗo, Cenɗo meeñaani.(tati) e ɗiɗaɓi o toownana daande mum, o juutina nde o ɓeyda: (Joom malaa'ika e Rooh (ko woni Jibra-eel).))
119.instruction: (Subhanal-malikil-quddoos.(three times).on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh.))

120.translation: (Alla, mi ko golloowo Ma, ɓi golloowo Ma, ɓi golloowo debbo Ma, koŋngi am e junngo Ma (ko woni A jogori kala dow mi), yamiroore Ma dow mi timmata abada, sarde Ma dow mi ko goonga. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma e innde kala Ma nde A innini Hoore Ma, walla A bayyini nder Deftere Ma, walla A kallani gooto e taguɓe Ma, walla A moofti e anndal ɓe suuɗii e Ma, waɗ Kuraan nguurndam ɓernde am e lewru ɓernde am, doggol haajeere am e wuttugol ɓaleel am.)
120.instruction: (Allahumma innee AAabduk, ibnu AAabdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, AAadlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw AAallamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee AAilmil-ghaybi AAindak, an tajAAalal-Qurana rabeeAAa qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee.)

121.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e ɓaleel e haajeere, leemugol e waalugol, gonndal e ŋakkaare, doɓɓere jaaɓɗe e jaɓɗeede e yimɓe.)
121.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.)

122.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla Tiiɗɗo Muusɗo. Alaa dewum so Alla, Joom jakkirgol mawngol. Alaa dewum so Alla, Joom kammuwe, Joom leydi e Joom jakkirgol teddungal.)
122.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahul-AAatheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem, la ilaha illal-lahu  rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-AAarshil-kareem.)

123.translation: (Alla, yiurnde Ma mi ɓattoo, wata A acca mi e koɗɗaɗe am hay sahaa wittude gite. Feewnaa mi koɗɗaɗe am fow. Alaa dewum so A.)
123.instruction: (Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant.)

124.translation: (Alaa dewum so A. A meeñaani, tigi miɗo wonnoo e tooñooɓe.)
124.instruction: (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen.)

125.translation: (Alla, Alla ko Joomiɗo am, mi bolee hay huunde e O.)

126.translation: (Alla, min kaɗa Ma yeeso maɓɓe, min ngaha kaldugo e Ma e bonan maɓɓe.)
126.instruction: (Allahumma inna najAAaluka fee nuhoorihim wanaAAoothu bika min shuroorihim.)

127.translation: (Alla, A ko walliɗo am, A ko wallinoowo am, e Ma mi ndira, e Ma mi njaloo, e Ma mi kaɓoo.)
127.instruction: (Allahumma anta AAadudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil)

129.translation: Alla, Joom kammuwe joweeɗɗi, Joom Jakkirgol Mawngol, won jaaroowo am e [neɗɗo toɗɗo] e walliɓe mum e taguɓe Ma, hay gooto maɓɓe tooñoo mi walla bonu mi. Mawnɗe ko kaldugo Ma, teddungal ko tanore Ma. Alaa dewum so A.
129.instruction: Allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Kun lee jaaran min (here you mention the person's name) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'Azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.

130.translation: Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Tiiɗɗo ɓuri taguɓe O fow. O Tiiɗɗo ɓuri ko mi kulaa mi haɗaa. Miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla, mo alaa dewum so O. O ko O haɗɗoo kammuwe joweeɗɗi raggude dow leydi so alaa yamiroore O. [Miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma Alla] e bonan golloowo Ma [innde neɗɗo], e walliɓe mum, jooɗɓe mum e balliɓe mum e jinn e yimɓe. Alla, won balliɗo am e bonan maɓɓe. Teddungal ko tanore Ma, mawnɗe ko kaldugo Ma. Innde Ma barkinɗe, alaa dewum goonga so A. (Tawa tati e Arabic)
130.instruction: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, Jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka.

131.translation: (Alla, Ummiinuɗo Deftere, Yaawo hisaabe, jaɓɓina gondiiɓe ɓe. Alla, jaɓɓina ɓe, dimbina ɓe.)

132.translation: (Alla, reen mi e ɓe e ko A suɓi.)

133.translation: (Wiyu:) miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla. (Ɓaawo ɗum dilla ko A nder sikke e ɗum.)
133.instruction: (Wiyu:) miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla. (Ɓaawo ɗum dilla ko A nder sikke e ɗum.)

134.translation: (O wiyu: (Ngoɗɗu mi e Alla e Nelaaɓe mum.))

135.translation: (O tawa kadi aaya ɗoo: (O ko Fuɗɗoowo e Cakkitiiɗo, Aththahir e Al-Batin, O anndi kala huunde no feewiri.)(Aththahir: jirta mawninde halluɗi O e tuttingol taguɓe kala yeeso mawninde O e toowngol O, sabu O dow taguɓe O fow e nderka O e halluɗi O.)(Al-Batin: jirta faamu O e anndal O e suuɗɗe fow, ko nder ɓerɗe e ko ɓuri hirtaade, no ɗum jirtirta ɓadiiɗe O e ɓadiiɗe O e fow e laawal moƴƴo teddungal O.))
135.instruction: (He should also recite the following verse: ( Huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleem))

136.translation: (Alla, heeɓnaa mi ko halaal e waɗde ko haraam, heeɓnaa mi e baabawal Ma e koɗɗal yimɓe goɗɓe.)
136.instruction: (Allahummak-finee bihalalika AAan haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika AAamman siwak.)

137.translation: (Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e ɓaleel e haajeere, leemugol e waalugol, gonndal e ŋakkaare, doɓɓere jaaɓɗe e jaɓɗeede e yimɓe.)
137.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasal, walbukhl, waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal)

138.translation: (Othman Ibn Al-AAas wiyi haala: Mi wiyi 'E Nelaaɗo Alla, tigi seytaan arata hakkunde mi e salaat am e tawugol am, woɗa mi miijooji' Nelaaɗo Alla jaabii 'Ɗum ko seytaan wiyeteengol Khanzab, so A heɓi woodgol mum, ɗuɓɓu kaldugo e Alla e mum, fuu (fuugol ko ɓuri yem e ndokku tutti) e nano càmman tati.)

139.translation: (Alla, alaa yaasnde so ko A yaasni, A waɗoo ɗiɗɗude, so A yiɗi, yaasnde.)
139.instruction: (Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla, wa-anta tajAAalul- hazana in shi'ta sahla.)

140.translation: (Golloowo kala waɗi hakkee, ɓaawo ɗum o ablusi, o salaa ɗiɗi rakaa (ko woni ɗiɗi rakAAa) ɓaawo ɗum o ɗuɓɓoo yaafre Alla, Alla yaafa o.)

143.translation: (Tawugol Kuraan e binndanɗe goonga siinugol e ɗu'aaji.)(yeru: 'Wata ɓeɗɓe kaɓirɗe maɓɓe no kaabirɗe, tigi seytaanɓe dogoo e galle ɗo Soorat Al-Baqarah tawetee' haala Muslim 1/539, kadi ɗu'aaji e siinugol subaka e hiirnaande, ɓaawo fonndugo, e sahaa ummugo, naatde e yaltude ɓuuɓɗe, naatde e yaltude juulirde, tawugol aayat Al-kursiyy e aayaaji ɗiɗi cakkitiiɗi Soorat Al-Baqarah ɓaawo fonndugo, adhaan...e goɗɗum.)

144.translation: (Alla sarii, ko O yiɗi O waɗi.)(tigi 'So' naata gollol seytaan.)

145.translation: Alla barikina ma e ko O hokki ma, A (baabiiɗo kesiɗo) jettaa, ɓiɗɗo heɓa mawnugol duuɓi, A hokkee goonga ɗum. Jaabol mooftaangoowo ko wiyde: Alla barikina ma, ummiina barkeeji O dow ma, Alla yoɓa ma no feewiri, hokku ma no ɗum, yoɓa ma no heewiri.
145.instruction: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu.  The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka.

146.translation: (Ibn AAabbas wiyi haala Nelaaɗo Alla ɗon kaɗa Al-Hasan e Al-Husayn e kaldugo Alla, wiyoo: (Miɗo kaɗa maɓɓe ɗiɗo e kaldugo wolde Alla timmuɗe e seytaan kala, mbollu kala, e gite bonnde kala.))
146.instruction: (Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah  used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(OAAeethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli AAaynin lammah.))

147.translation: (Hay saɓ, nde (ndaneele) wonata ciilnde, so Alla yiɗi.)

148.translation: (Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Alla Tiiɗɗo, Joom jakkirgol mawngol, woynaa ma'.(7 wolde) (o (ndanɗo) woynatee.))

149.translation: (Ali Ibn Abee Talib wiyi haala o nano Nelaaɗo Alla wiyoo: 'So gorko ndilli muslim ɓikkoy mum ndanɗo, ko no o yaha yekkoo ɓiɓɓe Jannat haa o jooɗo, so o jooɗi o naanaa e yiurnde, so ɗum subaka, malaa'ika miliyoŋ joweeɗɗi nela salaat dow mum haa hiirnaande, so ɗum hiirnaande, malaa'ika miliyoŋ joweeɗɗi nela salaat dow mum haa subaka.)

150.translation: 'Alla, yaaf mi, yurma mi, hawtu mi e gondiiɓe toowɓe ɓe

151.translation: 'Aa.ishah (Alla jaɓa o) wiyi haala Nelaaɗo (Alla nela o salaat e jam) [nder ndaneele nde o wari] ɗon leppa junngooji mum nder ndiyam, ɓaawo ɗum o yoomba yeeso mum, o wiyoo: 'Alaa dewum so Alla, tigi maayde jogori tammbere.'
151.instruction: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) wiyi haala Nelaaɗo (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [nder ndaneele nde o wari] ɗon leppa junngooji mum nder ndiyam, ɓaawo ɗum o yoomba yeeso mum, o wiyoo:[La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.]

152.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude. Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto. Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O. Alaa dewum so Alla, O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow. Alaa dewum so Alla, alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla.)
152.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

153.translation: ko woni ɓe ɓadiiɓe ndanɗo foti kallinde, hirkina o wiyde shahadah. (Mo wolde cakkitiiɗe mum ko: (Alaa dewum so Alla.) naata Jannat.)
153.instruction: ko woni ɓe ɓadiiɓe ndanɗo foti kallinde, hirkina o wiyde shahadah. (Mo wolde cakkitiiɗe mum ko: (La ilaha illal-lah.) naata Jannat.)

154.translation: (Min ko Alla, O min ruttoto. Alla, yoɓa mi e fittaare am, lomtina mi ɗum e ko ɓuri moƴƴude.)
154.instruction: (Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi rajiAAoon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha.)

155.translation: (Alla, yaaf -ɗoo innde maayɗo haaletee- toowna daraja mum nder fewnuɓe, won lomtoomo ɓe o woppi ɓaawo, yaaf amin e o E Joom adunaaruuji. Yaajna suudu mum, weltina nde.)(Lomtoomo: mo lomtii goɗɗo sabu ɗoo alaa walla o maayi. Ɗum ko maanaa goonga wolde khaleefah; woondaa goonga goɗɗe wiyi Adam ko khaleefah (lomtoomo, no firtaataa) Alla dow leydi sabu Alla haɗaa abada, o maayataa abada. Ɗu'aa ɗoo hollaa faamu goonga konngol ɗoo, hollaa Alla lomtoo amin, reena ɓe min woppa so min maayi walla min alaa (yeeɓu kadi ɗu'aa #198).)
155.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfaAA darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee AAaqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-AAalameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh.)

156.translation: (Alla, yaaf o, yurma o, jaɓa o, yaaf o, teddina joodoɗum mum. Yaajna naatgol mum, ɓoyna o e ndiyam, mbuus e lemre, ciilna o hakkeeji no laɓɓe daneeje ciilaa ɓaleejum. Yeelitoo galle mum e galle ɓurngol moƴƴude, yimɓe mum e yimɓe ɓurnɓe moƴƴude, gondiiɗo mum e gondiiɗo ɓurnɗo moƴƴude. Naata o e Jannat, reen o e jaɓɓorgol kaburu e jaɓɓorgol Jasiika.)
156.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, waAAafihi, waAAfu AAanh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassiAA mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-aAAithhu min AAathabil-qabr, waAAathabin-nar)

157.translation: (Alla, yaaf nguurɓe amin e maayɓe amin, ɓe ngoodi e ɓe ngalaa, ɓiɓɓe amin e mawɓe amin, worɓe amin e debbooji amin. Alla, mo A hokkii nguurndam e amin, waɗ nguurndam ɗam e Lislaam, mo A ittii e amin, waɗ maayde nde e goongɗingal. Alla, wata A haɗa amin njoɓdi mum, wata A wayla amin ɓaawo mum.)
157.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi AAalal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu AAalal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana baAAdah.)

158.translation: (Alla, toɗɗo ko nder reentugol Ma e kaldugo Ma, reen o e ɓaleel kaburu e jaɓɓorgol Jasiika. Tigi A ko jokkudoowo e goonga. Yaaf o, yurma o, tigi A ko Yaafowoowo ɓurɗo, Yiurmoowo ɓurɗo.)
158.instruction: (Allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr waAAathabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem.)

159.translation: (Alla, golloowo Ma e ɓi golloowo debbo Ma ko muuɗɗo yiurnde Ma, A ɓaanaa jaɓɓorgol mum. So o wonnoo goonga, ɓeyda njoɓdi mum, so o wonnoo bonɗo, yeewtoo hakkeeji mum.)
159.instruction: (Allahumma AAabduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun AAan AAathabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz AAanh.)

160.translation: Alla, reen o e jaɓɓorgol kaburu. [ko moƴƴi kadi wiyde] Alla, waɗ o artooowo, jokkintooowo e jawdi baabiiɓe mum e ƴeewtooowo jaɓɓaangowo. Alla, teddina nder miizaani maɓɓe (moƴƴe), mawnina njoɓdi maɓɓe. Hawtu o e goonga goongɗuɓe. Kaɗa o e reentugol Ibraheem. Danndoo o e yiurnde Ma e jaɓɓorgol Jahiim. Hokku o galle ɓurngol galle mum moƴƴude, yimɓe ɓurnɓe yimɓe mum moƴƴude. Alla, yaaf ɓe ndii ɓaawo amin, ɓiɓɓe amin majjuɓe (e maayde), e ɓe ndii ɓaawo amin e Goongɗingal.
160.instruction: (Allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) [or say:](Allahummaj-AAalhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafeeAAan mujaban. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-aAAthim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, wajAAalhu fee kafalati Ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika AAathabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan)

161.translation: (Alla, waɗ o aminen artooowo, jokkintooowo e sababu njoɓdi)

162.translation: (Tigi Alla jogori ko O ittii, O jogori ko O hokki, kala huunde e O jogori wakkati toɗɗaaɗo...ɓaawo ɗum o yamiri o muusoo, ɓattoo njoɓdi Alla.)(Wolde (faltasbir waltahtasib) ko yamiroore e debbo ɗiɗaɓo neɗɗo, ɗum waylataa e mo haaletee.)
162.instruction: (Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta, wakullu shayin AAindahu bi-ajalin musamma…faltasbir waltahtasib.)

163.translation: (E innde Alla e dow sunnah Nelaaɗo Alla.)

164.translation: Alla, yaaf o. Alla, tiina o

165.translation: (Jam dow maɓɓe fow, E yimɓe kaabirɗe, nder goongɗuɓe e muslimɓe. Tigi amin, so Alla yiɗi, maa min hawtu e maɓɓe, min ɗuɓɓoo Alla cellal aminen e maɓɓe.)
165.instruction: (Assalamu AAalaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-AAafiyah.)

166.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma moƴƴe ɗum, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e bonan ɗum.)
166.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha.)

167.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma moƴƴe ɗum, moƴƴe nder ɗum, moƴƴe ɗum neldinaa, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e bonan ɗum, bonan nder ɗum, bonan ɗum neldinaa.)
167.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih.)

168.translation: (O meeñaani, (O) mo baal ɗin wiyoo meeñugol O e tanore O, malaa'ika kadi e kulle O.)

169.translation: (Alla, ɓoggina amin ɓoggol balliɗo, ɓoggol nguuriɗo, ɓoggol weltinaɗo, ɓoggol nafaaɗo alaa bonaaɗo, jooni alaa ɓaawo.)
169.instruction: (Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an mureeAAan, nafiAAan, ghayra dar, AAajilan ghayra ajil.)

170.translation: (Alla, wuttina amin, Alla, wuttina amin, Alla, wuttina amin.)

171.translation: (Alla, hokku ndiyam gollooɓe Ma e ɓalli Ma, wuurtina yiurnde Ma, ummiina leydi Ma maayndi.)
171.instruction: (Allahummas-qi AAibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit.)

173.translation: (Min keɓi ɓoggol e baabawal e yiurnde Alla.)

174.translation: (Alla, waɗ ɓoggol waaɓa amin wata dow amin, Alla, (waɗ ɗum) dow ladde, tuli, leeje e ɓaaje leɗɗe.)
174.instruction: (Allahumma hawalayna wala AAalayna, allahumma AAalal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar.)

175.translation: (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude. Alla, waɗ lewru keso feeñoo dow amin e kisal, goongɗingal, jam e Lislaam, e jabbugol e kala ko A yiɗi A jaɓi. Joomiɗo amin e Joomiɗo ma ko Alla.)
175.instruction: (Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah.)

176.translation: (Yoorol foti, ɓaaje njamaa, njoɓdi teeŋtinaa, so Alla yiɗi.)

177.translation: (Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma e yiurnde Ma nde yaabi kala huunde, Yaaf mi.)
177.instruction: (Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasiAAat kulla shay, an taghfira lee.)

178.translation: (So A ɗon ɲaama, A wiyu:(Bismil-lah.)so A yejjiti wiyde ɗum ɓaawo fuɗɗude, A wiyu (so A siftini):E innde Alla e fuɗɗugol e cakkitugol ɗum.)
178.instruction: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.)

179.translation: (Mo Alla ɲaami, o wiyu:(Alla, barikina amin ɗum, ɲaamina amin ko ɓuri ɗum moƴƴude.) mo Alla hokkii kosam, o wiyu:(Alla, barikina amin ɗum, ɓeyda amin e ɗum.))
179.instruction: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-atAAimna khayran minh.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.))

180.translation: (Tanore fow ko Alla mo ɲaami mi ɗoo, hokkii mi ɗum alaa sekaa walla fange e mi.)
180.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

181.translation: (Alla tanaa e tanore heewnde moƴƴnde barkinɗe, tanore nde waktataa abada, tanore nde min yedditotaa, tanore nde min ɓaanaa, O ko Joomiɗo amin.)(Won miijooji goɗɗi e faamu ɗu'aa ɗoo, e mum: Alla tanaa e tanore heewnde moƴƴnde barkinɗe. O ko O heeɓi, O ɲaamoo, O ɲaameteeɗaa. O muuyaaɗo, e ko e O, O ko muuɗɗo, O ko Joomiɗo amin.)
181.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwaddaAAin, wala mustaghnan AAanhu rabbuna.)

182.translation: (Alla, barikina ɓe, ko A hokkii ɓe, yaaf ɓe, yurma ɓe.)
182.instruction: (Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.)

183.translation: (Alla, ɲaama mo ɲaami mi, hokku yarndam mo hokkii mi yarndam.)
183.instruction: (Allahumma atAAim man atAAamanee wasqi man saqanee.)

184.translation: (Maa sunɓe sooba nder galle ma, maa goonga cenɓe ɲaama ɲaamdu ma, maa malaa'ika nela salaat dow ma.)

185.translation: (So gooto maɓɓe noddetee (e ɲaamdu) o jaaboo. So o ɗon suna, o ɗu'aa (ɓe ngoodi), so o sunaa, o ɲaama.)

187.translation: (Alla, barikina amin ɓiɓɓe amin, barikina amin wuro amin, barikina amin saAA amin, barikina amin mudd amin.)(SaAA ko ɗiɗi mudd nayi, mudd ko miizorde wooɗorde ɗiɗi junngooji gorko hakkundeejo.)
187.instruction: (Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina, wabarik lana fee saAAina wabarik lana fee muddina.)

188.translation: (So gooto maɓɓe haasiri o wiyu:(Tanore fow ko Alla.) ɓikkoy mum walla gondiiɗo mum wiyu o:(Alla yurma ma.) o (mo haasiri) jaaboo o:(Alla fewinaa ma, feewnaa hakkilenaagu ma.))
188.instruction: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(Alhamdu lillah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (Yarhamukal-lah.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.))

190.translation: (Alla barikina ma (gondiiɗo ma), barikina ma, hawtu maɓɓe ɗiɗo e moƴƴe.)
190.instruction: (Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr.)

191.translation: (so A resi debbo walla A soodi maccuɗo debbo, A wiyu:(Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma moƴƴe nder mum, moƴƴe A tagi o e mum, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e bonan nder mum e bonan A tagi o e mum.))(so A soodi ngeelooba, A joga koggol mum, wiyu no ɗum.)
191.instruction: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha AAalayh.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)

192.translation: (E innde Alla. Alla, woddina seytaan e amin, woddina seytaan e ko A barikini amin.)

193.translation: (Miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla e seytaan riiwaaɗo.)

194.translation: (Tanore fow ko Alla mo wutti mi e ko O ɓalelii ma e ɗum, O ɓurini mi ɗuuɗɗe e taguɓe O ɓurngol.)
194.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee AAala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela.)

195.translation: (Ibn AAumar wiyi: Limetee Nelaaɗo Alla wiyoo wolde teemedere e joodoɗum goɗɗum ɓaawo ummude: (E Joomiɗo am, yaaf mi, ruttoo e mi (jaɓoo tobubugol am). Tigi A ko Ruttitooowo ɓurɗo, Yaafowoowo ɓurɗo.))
195.instruction: (Ibn AAumar  said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.))

196.translation: (A meeñaani E Alla, mi tantana Ma. Miɗo seedee Alaa dewum so A. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo yaafre Ma, miɗo ruttoto e Ma e tobubugol.)
196.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

197.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis wiyi: 'Mi yahi yeeɓde Nelaaɗo, mi ɲaami e ɲaamdu mum, mi wiyi o: (Alla yaaf ma, E Nelaaɗo Alla.) o jaabii: (e ma.))
197.instruction: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis  said: ‘I went to see the Prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him:(Ghafaral-lahu laka ya rasoolal-lah.) he  replied: (wa-lak))

198.translation: (So gooto waɗii ma moƴƴe, A wiyi: (Alla yoɓa ma moƴƴe.) A ɓuri o tanore.)
198.instruction: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (Jazakal-lahu khayran.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)

199.translation: (Dajjal: e maandeeji mawɗi wakkati cakkitiingol e ɓaleelji mawɗi ɓetooji yimɓe, Nelaaɗo kala tintini ɗum. Yimɓe ɗuuɗɓe ɓe mbi'a mum. O feeñata Asbahan, Iran wakkati mo muslimɓe keɓata Constantinople. O hokketee sekaa keeriingu, o waɗata goonga waylu fewre, fewre waylu goonga. O wiyata o goonga, o wiyata o nelaaɗo, e cakkitiiɗum, o wiyata o dewum. E maandeeji mum: o doɗa gite nano, ngon ko seereh tiinɗo haɗa jaggol mum dewum, ko maande feewugol. Wolde Kafir winndetee hakkunde gite mum, goonguɗo kala, jannguɗo walla janngaaniɗo, anndinta nde.)(Mo waɗi e sikke sappo fuɗɗeeje Soorat Al-Kahf reentee e Dajjal.)(Neɗɗo foti kadi yaha kaldugo e Alla e ɓaleelji Dajjal ɓaawo tashahhud cakkitiingol nder salaat. (Yeeɓu ɗu'aaji #55 e #56))

200.translation: (Mo A yidi mi e O, yira ma.)

201.translation: (Alla barikina ma, yimɓe ma e jawdi ma.)

202.translation: (Alla barikina ma, yimɓe ma e jawdi ma. Tigi tanore e yoɓde ko njoɓdi jaawngal.)
202.instruction: (Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.)

203.translation: (shirk: boleede goɗɓe e Alla e koɗɗe ɓe ko O tan. Ɗum waawi feeñde e (1) goɗɗum, yeru goɗɗe wiyi goɗɗo so Alla jogori sekaa nafaade walla bonaade, (2) wolde, yeru woondude e goɗɗo so Alla, (3) gollol, yeru ʋuuɗude walla suujudude goɗɗo so Alla.)(Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma yiide waɗde shirk e Ma e anndal, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo yaafre Ma ko mi anndaa.)
203.instruction: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an oshrika bika wa-ana aAAlam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la aAAlam.)

204.translation: (Aaishah wiyi haala Nelaaɗo Alla hokkaa male, o yamiri feccugol mum. So golloowo artii (e feccugol), AAaishah ɗuɓɓoo o: 'Ko ɓe mbi'i?', o jaabii: Ɓe ɗu'aa: (Alla barikina maɓɓe fow.) AAaishah wiyata: (Alla barikina ɓe kadi.))(min ruttoo ɗu'aa maɓɓe e laawal nanngungal, njoɓdi amin ɗon heeɓi amin.)
204.instruction: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah  was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution.  When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (Barakal-lahu feekum.) AAaishah would then say: (Wafeehim barakal-lah.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)

205.translation: (Ɗu'aa ɗoo kuutoretee so neɗɗo fuɗɗii miijde kewu kewingol jirtaa moƴƴe walla bonde, kuutoro ɗum no darnde suɓaade gollol mo o waɗata, ɓaawo ɗum o haɗa jokkondiral ɗam, o yaha kaldugo e Alla, o wiyoo ɗu'aa ɗoo no ciilgol gollol ngol, sabu ngol naata nder shirk.)(Alla, alaa maande so kaldugo e Ma, alaa moƴƴe so moƴƴe Ma, alaa dewum so A.)
205.instruction: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.)

206.translation: (E innde Alla, tanore fow ko Alla. O meeñaani, O kaɗiɗo ɗoo (joorde) e gollal amin, amin hoore amin min waawataa ɗum, e Joomiɗo amin ko artgol amin. Tanore fow ko Alla, tanore fow ko Alla, tanore fow ko Alla, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude. A meeñaani E Alla, tigi mi tooñi neɗɗaagal am, Yaaf mi, tigi alaa moya yaaf hakkeeji so A.)
206.instruction: (Bismil-lah, walhamdu lillah, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanakal-lahumma innee thalamtu nafsee faghfir lee fainnahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.)

207.translation: (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude. O meeñaani, O kaɗiɗo ɗoo (joorde) e gollal amin, amin hoore amin min waawataa ɗum, e Joomiɗo amin ko artgol amin. Alla, min ɗuɓɓoo Ma birr e taqwa nder tummude amin ɗoo, min ɗuɓɓoo Ma golle jaɓɓooɗe Ma. Alla, yaasnaa amin tummude amin, yaawna amin juutde mum. Alla, A ko Gondiiɗo e tummude e Lomtoomo dow yimɓe, Alla, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e caale tummude, e waylugol ɓerɗe e woodde e bonde, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e artgol bonngol e jawdi e yimɓe.)(birr e taqwa: konnguɗi ɗiɗi mawɗi ɗi kala, ceeraade, jirtaa golle moƴƴe fow e jokkugol ko woni waɗde golle yamiraaɗe e woppude golle haɗaaɗe. So ɗi hawtii, birr jirtaa waɗde golle yamiraaɗe, taqwa jirtaa woppude golle haɗaaɗe.)(Lomtoomo: mo lomtii goɗɗo sabu ɗoo alaa walla o maayi. Ɗum ko maanaa goonga wolde khaleefah; woondaa goonga goɗɗe wiyi Adam ko khaleefah Alla dow leydi sabu Alla haɗaa abada, o maayataa abada. Ɗu'aa ɗoo hollaa faamu goonga konngol ɗoo, hollaa Alla lomtoo amin, reena ɓe min woppa so min maayi walla min alaa.)(e artgol ɗu'aa ɗum tawetee e ɓeydugol ɗoo: (Min arti, min tobubugii, min adabi, min tantani Joomiɗo amin.))
207.instruction: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wa-inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, allahumma inna nas-aluka fee safarina hatha albirra wattaqwa, waminal-AAamali ma tarda, allahumma hawwin AAalayna safarana hatha, watwi AAanna buAAdah, allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, walkhaleefatu fil-ahl, allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min waAAtha-is-safar, waka-abatil-manthar, wasoo-il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: (Ayiboona, ta-iboona, AAabidoona, lirabbina hamidoon.))

208.translation: (Alla, Joom kammuwe joweeɗɗi e kala ko ɗi mbiri, Joom leɗɗi joweeɗɗi e kala ko ɗi ɓooɗi, Joom seytaanɓe e kala mo ɓe wayli, Joom henɗu e kala ko ɗum yaɓi. Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo Ma moƴƴe wuro ɗoo, moƴƴe yimɓe mum e moƴƴe fow nder mum, miɗo yaha kaldugo e Ma e bonan wuro ɗoo, bonan yimɓe mum e bonan fow nder mum.)
208.instruction: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAAi wama athlaln, warabbal-aradeenas-sabAAi wama aqlaln, warabbash-shayateeni wama adlaln, warabbar-riyahi wama tharayn, as-aluka khayra hathihil-qaryah, wakhayra ahlilha wakhayra ma feeha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ahliha, washarri ma feeha.)

209.translation: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O, O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow. O hokkoo nguurndam O hokkoo maayde, O nguuri O maayaa. E junngo O ko moƴƴe fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde.)
209.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah,  wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa hayyun la yamoot, biyadihil-khayru wahuwa  AAala kulli shayin qadeer.)

211.translation: (Miɗo kaɗa ma e amaana Alla, mo amaana mum majjaa abada.)

212.translation: (Miɗo kaɗa goongɗingal ma, goonga ma e cakkitiiɗi golle ma e amaana Alla.)

213.translation: (Alla heeɓnaa ma taqwa, yaaf hakkeeji ma, yaasnaa ma moƴƴe fow, ɗo A woni fow.)(taqwa: konngol mawngol jirtaangol golle moƴƴe fow e jokkugol ko woni waɗde golle yamiraaɗe e woppude golle haɗaaɗe.)
213.instruction: (Zawwadakal-lahut-taqwa, waghafara thanbak, wayassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunt.)

214.translation: Jabir wiyi: So min ɓuli tulde min wiyoo Allaahu 'Akber (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude), so min ɗowii min wiyoo Subhaanallaah (Alla meeñaani)

215.translation: (Maa seedoowo seedee tanore amin Alla e moƴƴe O e barkeeji O dow amin. Joomiɗo amin, reen amin, waɗ moƴƴe dow amin, danndoo amin e bonde kala. Miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla e jasiika.)
215.instruction: (SamiAAa samiAAun bihamdil-lahi wahusni bala-ihi AAalayna. Rabbana sahibna wa-afdil AAalayna AAa-ithan billahi minan-nar.)

216.translation: (Miɗo yaha kaldugo e wolde Alla timmuɗe e bonan ko O tagi.)

217.translation: (Ibn AAumar wiyi haala Nelaaɗo Alla e artgol e kaɓgol walla hajj wiyoo e kala nokku toowngol: (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude.) ɓaawo ɗum o wiyoo: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O. O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde. Min arti, min tobubugii, min adabi, min tantani Joomiɗo amin. Alla timmini ɓoɗɗal O, walli golloowo O, jaɓɓini gondiiɓe ɓe O gooto.))
217.instruction: (Ibn AAumar  reported that the Messenger of Allah  on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.) and then he would say: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, ayiboona ta-iboon, AAabidoon, lirabbina hamidoon, sadaqal-lahu waAAdah, wanasara AAabdah, wahazamal-ahzaba wahdah.))

218.translation: So huunde kewi welnini o, Nelaaɗo ɗon wiyoo:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Tanore ko Alla mo e barkeeji O golle moƴƴe timmaa. So huunde kewi welnaani o, o ɗon wiyoo:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Tanore ko Alla e hakkilenaagu kala.
218.instruction: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)).And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).

219.translation: (Nelaaɗo (jam dow mum) wiyi: 'Mo nela salaat gooto dow mi, Alla nela sappo dow mum.)

220.translation: (O (jam dow mum) wiyi kadi: 'Wata ɓeɗɓe suudu am nokku gollol ɓaawo-ɓaawo. Nelaa salaat dow mi, tigi salaat maɓɓe yettaa mi ɗo ɓeɗɓe woni fow.)

221.translation: (O (jam dow mum) wiyi kadi: 'Gonndɗo ko mo, so mi haaletee e mum, haɗi neldude salaat dow mi.)

222.translation: Nelaaɗo [jam dow mum] wiyi:'Tigi Alla jogori malaa'ika yaaraaɓe leydi, ɓe njaɓa am noddugol (walla salaat jam) 'Ummah am (yimɓe).

223.translation: Nelaaɗo [jam dow mum] wiyi: 'Alaa mo nela noddugol (walla salaat jam) dow mi so Alla ruttoo neɗɗaagal am e mi si mi ruttoo noddugol mum

224.translation: (Nelaaɗo Alla wiyi: 'Ɓe naataa Jannat haa ɓe ngoɗɗi, ɓe ngoɗɗataa haa ɓe njari goɗɗo e goɗɗo. Mi haalana maɓɓe huunde, so ɓe kuutorii ɗum, ɓe keɓata yidde goɗɗo e goɗɗo? Wuurtinaa noddugol nder maɓɓe.)

225.translation: (Aammar wiyi: 'Halluɗi tati, mo hawtini ɗi, timmini goongɗingal mum: wonde goonga, wuurtinde noddugol e yimɓe fow e yoɓde (e ɓikkol) e seeda A jogori.)

226.translation: (Aabdullah Ibn Aamr wiyi haala gorko ɗuɓɓii Nelaaɗo: 'Lislaam foti ɓurngol moƴƴude?'. O jaabii: Ɲaama (miskineeɓe), nodda ɓe A anndi e ɓe A anndaa.)

227.translation: (So yimɓe Deftere noddi maɓɓe, jaaboo e wiyde: (E dow maɓɓe.))

228.translation: (So A nani jaŋŋugol ʋosngel, ɗuɓɓu Alla baabawal O sabu ɗum yeewi malaa'ika, so A nani wolde mbaldi, ɗuɓɓu kaldugo e Alla sabu ɗum yeewi seytaan.)

229.translation: (So A nani wolde dogɓe walla wolde mballi jamma, ɗuɓɓu kaldugo e Alla sabu ɓe nji'a ko ɓe nji'aa.)

230.translation: (Alla, goonguɗo kala mi tooñi, waɗ ɗum sababu ɓadiinde o e Ma ñalnde ummugol.)
230.instruction: (Allahumma fa-ayyuma mu/minin sababtuhu fajAAal thalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah.)

231.translation: (O wiyi: 'So gooto maɓɓe ɓaanaa tanore ɓikkoy mum, o wiyu: 'Miɗo miijoo toɗɗo ko...e Alla ko hisaaboowo O...mi tantana hay gooto, kaɗoo (ko woni tanore am) yeeso tanore Alla, kono miɗo miijoo o toɗɗo'...so o anndi ɗum e mum.)

232.translation: Alla, wata A hisaabina mi ko ɓe mbi'a, yaaf mi ko ɓe anndaa [waɗ mi ɓurngol ko ɓe miijoo].
232.instruction: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoona [waj'alnee khayram-mimmaa yadhunnoon]

233.translation: (Mi ngoodi E Alla, (e jaabugol noddaal Ma), mi ngoodi. Mi ngoodi, Alaa gondiiɗo Ma, mi ngoodi. Tigi tanore fow, baabawal e laamu ko Ma. Alaa gondiiɗo Ma.)
233.instruction: (Labbaykal-lahumma labbayk, labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wanniAAmata laka walmulk, la shareeka lak.)

234.translation: (Nelaaɗo tawtii KaAAbah e ngeelooba, kala sahaa o yetti kaaŋŋe ŋaleere o jirta e ɗum e mbalɗu mum, o wiyoo: (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude))
234.instruction: (The Prophet  circled the KaAAbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: (Allahu akbar))

235.translation: Nelaaɗo jam dow mum ɗon wiyoo hakkunde ɓutti Yaman e kaaŋŋe ŋaleere: (E Joomiɗo amin, hokku amin ɓurngol e aduna ɗoo e ɓurngol e aduna artooowo, reen amin e jaɓɓorgol Jasiika.)
235.instruction: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone: (Rabbana atina fee alddunya hasanatan wafee al-akhirati hasanatan waqina  AAathaba alnnar)[Al-Baqarah: 201]

236.translation: (Jabir wiyi e siftinde hajj Nelaaɗo: '...so o ɓadii tulde Safa o tawa: (Tigi Safa e Marwah ko e nokkuuje adaba Alla...)
