(Miɗo fuɗɓoo ko Alla fuɗɗii.) o fuɗɗii e Safa, o ɓuli nde haa o yeewi KaAAbah, o holliti e ɗum, o wiyi: (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude.) ɓaawo ɗum o wiyata ɗoo tati, ɗu'aa (neɗɗo foti waɗde ɗu'aa hoore mum) ɓaawo kala wolde: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O. O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde. Alaa dewum so Alla O gooto. O timmini ɓoɗɗal O, walli golloowo O, jaɓɓini gondiiɓe ɓe O gooto.)) (o ɗon waɗa kadi gollal ngal e Marwah.)
236.instruction: (Jabir  said when describing the Prophet’s  pilgrimage: ‘…and when he approached mount Safa he recited: ( Innas-safa wa-almarwata min shaAAa-iri Allah ….) (Abda-o bima badaal-lahu bih.) so he started with Safa and climed it until he could see the KaAAbah, he then faced it and said: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.) and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, anjaza waAAdah, wanasara AAabdah, wahazamal -ahzaba wahdah.)(he  would repeat this action at Marwah.)

237.translation: (Ɓurngol ɗu'aaji ko ɗu'aa ñalnde AAarafah, ɓurngol ko mi e Nelaaɓe ɓaawo am mbi'i (ko): (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O. O jogori tanore fow e laamu fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde.))
237.instruction: (The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of AAarafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is): (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.))

238.translation: Nelaaɗo yoɓi ngeelooba mum, Al-Qaswa, haa o yetti nokku ceno (Al-Mash aril Haraam). O holliti e Qiblah, o ɗu'aa Alla, o wiyoo kadi kadi: Allaahu Akbar (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude), Allaahu Ahad (Alla Gooto) e Laa ilaaha illallaah (Alaa dewum so Alla). O daroo haa kammu waylu jaamba e subaka, o ɓenni ɓaawo yalugol weeyo.

239.translation: Nelaaɗo jam dow mum wiyi Allaahu 'Akbar (Alla ɓurɗo mawnude) e kala kaaye o riga e tati teeŋŋe ɗe. O yahi yeeso, o daroo holliti e Qiblah, o toowni junngooji mum, o noddi Alla. Ɗum ɓaawo (rigde) teeŋnde arannde e ɗiɗaɓnde. Kono ɗiɗaɓnde, o rigi nde, o wiyi Allahu Akbar e kala kaaye o riga, kono so o joofi o yalti alaa o daroo e nde (ngam ɗu'aaji).

242.translation: (Nelaaɗo jam dow mum ɗon suujuda e jettaade Alla so o keɓi kewu welninngu walla ngaddu weltaare.)

243.translation: (Kaɗ junngo maa e nokku ɓalɗe, wiyu: (E innde Alla(tati)) ɓaawo ɗum ɗu'aa joweeɗɗi: (Miɗo yaha kaldugo e Alla e nder sekaa O e bonan ko mi heɓaa mi haɗaa.))
243.instruction: (Place your hand at the site of the pain and say: (Bismil-lah (three times)) the supplicate seven times: (aAAoothu billahi waqudratih min sharri ma ajidu wa-ohathir.))

244.translation: So A yeewi huunde e ɓikkoy maa welninndu, walla e neɗɗaagal mum walla e jawdi mum [ɗuɓɓu Alla barikina o e ɗum] sabu gite bonnde ko goonga.

246.translation: (E innde Alla, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude. Alla, (ko) Ma, ko Ma, Alla, jaɓa ɗoo e mi.)
246.instruction: (Bismil-lah wallahu akbar, allahumma minka walak, allahumma taqabbal  minnee.)

247.translation: (Miɗo yaha kaldugo nder wolde Alla timmuɗe ɗe goonga walla goongaaniɗo foti wakkataa, e bonan fow ko O tagi, waɗi, fuɗɗi. (Miɗo yaha kaldugo) e bonan ɗowoo e kammu e bonan ɓuloo e ɗum. (Miɗo yaha kaldugo) e bonan wuurteteende dow leydi e bonan wurtinaaɗe e mum, miɗo yaha kaldugo e bonan ɓaleelji jamma e weeyo, e bonan ndilliɗo jamma so alaa mo ɓuri moƴƴe, E Yiurmoowo.)
247.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat, allatee la yujawizuhunna barrun wala fajir min sharri ma khalaq, wabaraa watharaa, wamin sharri ma yanzilu minas-sama/, wamin sharri ma yaAAruju feeha, wamin sharri ma tharaa fil-ard, wamin sharri ma yakhruju minha, wamin sharri fitnanil-layli wannahar, wamin sharri kulli tariqin illa tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya Rahman.)

248.translation: (Nelaaɗo Alla wiyi: 'E Alla, miɗo ɗuɓɓoo yaafre, miɗo tobubugo e Alla, ɓuri wolde joweeɗɗi e ñalnde.)

249.translation: (O wiyi kadi: 'E yimɓe, Tobubugoo! Tigi miɗo tobubugo e Alla, wolde teemedere e ñalnde.)

250.translation: (O wiyi kadi: 'Mo wiyi:(Miɗo ɗuɓɓoo yaafre Alla, mo alaa dewum so O, Nguurɗo abada, Hoɗɗo e Hoore mum Walliinoowo fow, miɗo ruttoto e O e tobubugol.) Alla yaafa o hay so o dogii e ɓulgol konu.)
250.instruction: (He  also said: ‘Whoever says:(Astaghfirul-lahal-lathee la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu wa-atoobu ilayh.) Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.)

251.translation: (O wiyi: 'Joomiɗo ɓadii golloowo O ko hakkunde jamma, so A waawi wonde e ɓe siinoo Alla e wakkati ɗo, won ɗum.)

252.translation: (O wiyi kadi: 'Golloowo ɓadii Joomiɗo O ko sahaa o ɗon suujuda, ɗu'aa ɗuuɗɗe nder ɗum.)

253.translation: (O wiyi kadi: 'tigi ɓernde am woodaa, tigi miɗo ɗuɓɓoo yaafre Alla wolde teemedere e ñalnde.)(woodaa: ko woni e hakkilenaagu 'yejjitingol'. Nelaaɗo ɗon ɓeyda siinugol Joomiɗo O, keɓde ɓadiiɗe Alla e faamu Alla haa so tiinɗugol ɗam leemi e laawal kala, o yeewta ɗum no hakkee, o ɓenni ɗuɓɓude yaafre e Alla.)

254.translation: (Mo wiyi:(Alla meeñaani, mi tantana O.) wolde teemedere e ñalnde, hakkeeji mum ɓoynetee, hay so ɗi no mborru maayo.)
254.instruction: (Whoever says:(Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.) a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.)

255.translation: (Abu Hurayrah wiyi haala Nelaaɗo Alla wiyi: 'Mo wiyi: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto, alaa gondiiɗo O. O jogori laamu fow e tanore fow, O sekaa dow kala huunde.) wolde teemedere e ñalnde, jogori njoɓdi wuttude maccuɓe sappo, moƴƴe teemedere winndetee mum, ɓaleeji teemedere ɓoynetee, o heɓi kaldugo e seytaan ñalnde ɗum haa hiirnaande, alaa artooowo e ko ɓuri moƴƴude so alaa mo waɗi ɓuri.)
255.instruction: (Abu Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  said: ‘Whoever says: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.) a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.)

256.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah wiyi haala Nelaaɗo Alla wiyi:'(Won) wolde ɗiɗi, (ɗe) wooɗi e ɓengal, teddini e Miizorde, yidaaɗe e Yiurmoowo ɓurɗo: (Alla meeñaani, mi tantana O. Alla meeñaani, Tiiɗɗo.))
256.instruction: (Aboo Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  said:’(There are) Two words, (which are ) light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, wasubhanal-lahil-AAatheem.))

257.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah wiyi haala Nelaaɗo Alla wiyi: 'Wiyde: (Alla meeñaani, tanore fow ko Alla. Alaa dewum so Alla, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude.) ɓuri am yidde e kala ko weeyo ummi dow.)
257.instruction: (Aboo Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  said: ‘Saying: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar.) is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.)

258.translation: (Sa’d wiyi: 'Min njooɗoo e Nelaaɗo Alla, o wiyi: 'Hay gooto maɓɓe waawaa keɓde moƴƴe ujunneere kala ñalnde?' Gooto ɗuɓɓii o: No neɗɗo heɓirta moƴƴe ujunneere? O jaabii: 'O wiyu: (Alla meeñaani.) wolde teemedere, moƴƴe ujunneere winndetee mum walla ɓaleeji ujunneere ɓoynetee.)
258.instruction: (Sa’d  said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah , and he said: ‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him  : How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: (Subhanal-lah.) one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.)

259.translation: (Jabbir wiyi haala Nelaaɗo wiyi: 'Mo wiyi: (Alla meeñaani Tiiɗɗo, mi tantana O.) lekki palme tagee mum e Jannat.)
259.instruction: (Jabbir  related that the Prophet  said: ‘Whoever says: (Subhanal-lahil-AAatheemi wabihamdih.) a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.)

260.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays wiyi haala Nelaaɗo wiyi o: 'E AAabdullah Ibn Qays, mi haalana ma jawdi e jawdi Jannat?' O wiyi: 'Wiyu: (Alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla.))
260.instruction: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays  related that the Prophet  said to him: ‘ O ‘AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He  then said: ‘Say: (La  hawla wala quwwata illa billah.))

261.translation: (wolde ɓuri yidde e Alla ko nayi: (Alla meeñaani, tanore fow ko Alla. Alaa dewum so Alla, Alla ɓurɗo mawnude.))(saɓaa ko e mum A fuɗɓoo.)
261.instruction: (the most beloved words to Allah are four: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar.))(it does not matter which of them you start with.)

262.translation: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas wiyi haala gorko wari e Nelaaɗo Alla, o wiyi o: 'Kallan mi huunde mi wiyata?' O wiyi: 'Wiyu: (Alaa dewum so Alla, O gooto alaa gondiiɗo O. Alla ɓurɗo mawnude, tanore ɗuuɗɗe ko Alla. Alla meeñaani, Joom adunaaruuji. Alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla Tiiɗɗo, Hikimoowo.) gorko wiyi: 'Ɗee ko Joomiɗo am, ko am ko holi?' O jaabii: 'Wiyu:(Alla, yaaf mi, yurma mi, fewin mi, hokku mi riziqi.))
262.instruction: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas  narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah  and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, subhanal-lahi rabbil-AAalameen, la hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAazeezil-hakeem.) the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He  replied: ‘Say:(Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, warzuqnee.))

263.translation: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee wiyi: 'So gooto naati e Lislaam, Nelaaɗo kallina o no salirta, ɓaawo ɗum o yamira o ɗu'aa e wolde ɗee: (Alla, yaaf mi, yurma mi, fewin mi, weltina mi, hokku mi riziqi.))
263.instruction: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee  said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet  would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, waAAafinee warzuqnee.))

264.translation: (Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah wiyi haala Nelaaɗo Alla wiyi: 'Tigi, ɓurngol ɗu'aa ko: (Tanore fow ko Alla.) tigi, ɓurngol siinugol ko: (Alaa dewum so Alla.))
264.instruction: (Jabir  Ibn ‘AAabdullah  related that the Messenger of Allah  said: ‘Verily, the best supplication is: (Alhamdu lillah) and indeed, the best form of remembrance is: (La ilaha illal-lah.))

265.translation: Golle moƴƴe dooɗɗe ko 'Alla meeñaani', 'Tanore ko Alla', 'Alaa dewum so Alla', 'Alla ɓurɗo mawnude', 'Alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla'
265.instruction: The good deeds which endure are 'Subhaanallaah.', and 'Walhamdulillaah.', and 'Wa laa ilaaha illallaah'., and 'Wallaahu Akbar',and 'Wa laa hawla wa laa guwawala illaa billaah'.

266.translation: (Tasbeeh, maanaa ɗoo, wiyde: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.)) (AAabdullah Ibn AAamr wiyi: 'Mi yeewi nelaaɗo waɗoo tasbeeh e junngo nano ñaamo.)

267.translation: So hiirnaande ɗowi, naata ɓiɓɓe maɓɓe nder galle sabu seytaanɓe wuurtoto e sahaa ɗoo. Ɓaawo ɓaltugol sahaa (ko woni sahaa arannde) jamma, (A waawi) acca ɓe (ɓiɓɓe) yaha. Uddu ɓuuɓɗe maɓɓe e haalde Innde Alla, sabu seytaan uddataa ɓuuɓɗal uddaaɗal. Foƴƴa horɗe ndiyam maɓɓe e haalde Innde Alla. Suuɗa kaɓirɗe ɲaamdu maɓɓe e haalde Innde Alla hay so A kaɗi huunde dow mum, mbuusa laampe maɓɓe. Jam e barkeeji dow Nelaaɗo amin, Muhammad, e dow yimɓe mum e Gondiiɓe mum, ɓe fow.

name-2.instruction: O golloowo e miisneende ɓurnde | Quran: (2:163) (3: 31) (4:100) (5:3)

name-4.instruction: O cenaano e caale kala, meeñaano e ɓiɓɓe e haɗɗiiɓe | Quran: (59:23) (62:1)

name-5.instruction: O hokkoo jam, deendere e weltaare. E haalde innde ndee, min haalaa jam amin hoore amin e ɓe ɓadiiɓe amin. | Quran: (59:23)

name-6.instruction: Innde ndee ko suuɗɗo hay e muslimɓe sabu "Al-Mu'min" ummoraade e innde "Al-iman" nde maanaa goɗɗe, ɗo ummorii innde "Al-Mu'minoune" nde maanaa goongɗuɓe, ko innde Kuraan yimɓe goɗɗuɓe e 6: gootugol Alla, woodgol malaa'ika, defte cene (Tawraat, Injil e Zabuur (Zabor) waylaaɗe e Kuraan), nelaaɓe, ñalnde cakkitiingol (ñalnde sarde) e sarde bonan mum e moƴƴe mum. Maanaa tiinɗo innde ndee ko caɗtungol hirtinde e maanaa fuɗɗoɗo kono faametee e laawal juutngal e suuɗngal. | Quran: (59:23)

name-7.instruction: Mo laami taguɓe O e sekaa O e halluɗi fow, alaa hakkilenaagu walla hallu e aduna ɗoo walla goɗɗo doggi yiɗde O. | Quran: (59:23)

name-8.instruction: Tedduɗo e toowngol O e mawninde O, El-Aziz maanaa e laawal goɗɗal o yiɗaaɗo o teddungaɗo e gite taguɓe O. O wonaa golloowo taguɗo kala, alaa taguɗo yamiro o ko o waɗata. | Quran: (3:6)(4:15 8)(9:40)(4 8:7)

name-9.instruction: Mawnɗo, sekaaɗo cakkitiiɗo e mawninde O e fange O nde alaa keerol. So O bonni tooñooɓe (goongaaniɓe e hakkeeɓe) O kuutoroo sarde O e goonga. | Quran: (59:23)

name-10.instruction: O ɓuri taguɓe O, alaa taguɗo jogori haqq jaggude mawninde. | Quran: (59:23)

name-11.instruction: Taguɗo woodɗe fow, nguurɗe walla maayɗe, ndiraɗe walla darooɗe. | Quran: (6:102)(13:16)(39:62)(40:62)(59:24)

name-12.instruction: O toowni taguɓe O dow caale fow walla feewugol. | Quran: (59:24)

name-13.instruction: O hokkoo yaajre e bayyine taguɗo kala e nder e yaasi. E Arabic ɓennunde, konngol ngol maanaa tagaannoowo, e Arabic hannde maanaa fewinoowo. | Quran: (59:24)

name-14.instruction: O ko O yaaf ko O yiɗi mo O yiɗi. | Quran: (20:82)(38:66)(39:5)(40:42)(71:10)

name-15.instruction: O ko O sekaaɗo jaɓɓinde taguɓe fow e yiɗde O. | Quran: (13:16)(14:48)(38:65)(39:4)(40:16)

name-16.instruction: O ko O hokkoo no heewiri alaa o heɓaa ruttoore | Quran: (3:8)(38:9)(38:35)

name-17.instruction: O ko O feccoo taguɗo kala ko ɗum muuɗi. | Quran: (51:58)

name-18.instruction: O ko O tan anndi coktirɗe ko arata e ko anndaaka, e anndal O e hikima O. Innde ndee jokkondirtaa heewde e innde ɗoo ɓaawo "Al-'Alīm". | Quran: (34:26)

name-19.instruction: O mo alaa huunde suuɗoo e O, sabu O anndi kala huunde, O faami kala huunde. | Quran: (2:158)(3:92)(4:35)(24:41)(33:40)

name-20.instruction: O ko O ɓuuttoo moƴƴe O e hikima. | Quran: (2:245)

name-21.instruction: O ko O wuttoo, ɓeydoo, heeɓnoo moƴƴe O e hikima. | Quran: (2:245)

name-22.instruction: O ko O saroo tooñooɓe e kaaɓɓe e darjugol e jaɓɓorgol. | Quran: (95:5)

name-23.instruction: Mawninoowo e maanaa toowngol, o toownoo daraja, nokku e teddungal neɗɗo e aduna ɗoo ɗow e aduna artooowo. | Quran: (58:11)(6:83)

name-24.instruction: O hokkoo teddungal e kiis teddungal. | Quran: (3:26)

name-25.instruction: O ko O waawi tooɓɓde e darjude valiant kala. | Quran: (3:26)

name-26.instruction: O nanoo ƴeeƴre walla daande kala e laamu O ummoraande e taguɗo kala, kadi O nanoo ɗu'aaji taguɓe O jaaboo ɗu'aaji maɓɓe. | Quran: (2:127)(2:256)(8:17)(49:1)

name-27.instruction: O mo alaa huunde woodnde walla artunde doggi O alaa kuutore gite, kuutorgal walla hallu seeda. | Quran: (4:58)(17:1)(42:11)(42:27)

name-28.instruction: O ko O sariyo, yoɓɓoo hakkunde taguɓe ɗoo ɗow e aduna artooowo, O teeŋtinoo goonga hakkunde taguɓe, alaa goɗɗo waawata yoɓɓude hakkunde maɓɓe sariyoo ɓe; Sarde e aduna artooowo wonata goonga timmuɗo. | Quran: (22:69)

name-29.instruction: O ko O meeñaano e laawal kala tooñde e/walla bonan. | Quran: (6:115)

name-30.instruction: O ko O hokkoo taguɓe O yaasnde O e moƴƴe O. | Quran: (6:103)(22:63)(31:16)(33:34)

name-31.instruction: O ko O suuɗetaa goonga kala huunde woodnde, ko woni goonga koɗɗe; alaa detail doggi O, huunde fow walla kala taƴre mum; jaggude waawde suuɗde koɗɗe e O tagɗo kala ko mborre e goɗɗum-gaanaa. | Quran: (6:18)(17:30)(49:13)(59:18)

name-32.instruction: O ko muusɗo O e goɗɗum-gaanaa hakkeeɓe ɓuri miijoo fow (woodi yaafre hokketaa ɓe). | Quran: (2:235)(17:44)(22:59)(35:41)

name-33.instruction: Innde ndee caɗtunde firtaade sabu ɗum hawti konnguɗi ɗuuɗɗi ɗi keeri miijooji ɓiɗɗi, kono faametee no ɗoo: "Al-Adhīm" O Mawnɗo Teddungal e Ɗakkuɗo ɓuru moƴƴude, woɗɗo caale ɓanndu walla kuugal. | Quran: (2:255)(42:4)(56:96)

name-34.instruction: O ko O yaaf no heewiri kadi kadi. | Quran: (2:173)(8:69)(16:110)(41:32)

name-35.instruction: O ko O hollitoo jaɓɗe O adooɓe, hay so ɗum yaasni no waawaa miijeede. | Quran: (35:30)(35:34)(42:23)(64:17)

name-36.instruction: O ko O dow kala ko O tagi no timmuɗo, no miijeteeɗaa. | Quran: (4:34)(31:30)(42:4)(42:51)

name-37.instruction: Mawɗo: O ɓuri taguɓe O mawnude, mawninde mo O tan anndi. | Quran: (13:9)(22:62)(31:30)

name-38.instruction: O ko O reeno, mooftoo moƴƴe O. | Quran: (11:57)(34:21)(42:6)

name-40.instruction: O ko O limata koɗɗe taguɓe O fow alaa yejjitingol walla juumre. | Quran: (4:6)(4:86)(33:39)

name-46.instruction: O mo Hikima O haɓɓi, haɓɓoo, haɓɓata hakkilenaagu kala faamaango hakkilanoowo. | Quran: (31:27)(46:2)(57:1)(66:2)

name-47.instruction: Konngol ngol e Arabic maanaa: O ɓadiiɗo yiɗaaɗo O e yiurnde, cillaale e moƴƴe, kono so neɗɗo jangi innde ndee nder "Kuraan", o heɓoo kala sahaa miijooji ceertuɗi caɗtuɗi firtaade e konnguɗi}. Min waawi etaade firtaade ɗum: O ɓadiiɗo gollooɓe O e cillaale hay so ɓe woɗɗii O, ɓe teddinii O. | Quran: (11:90)(85:14)

name-48.instruction: O ko O teddungaa e ɓennunde alaa keerol, jooni e duuɓiɗum. | Quran: (11:73)

name-49.instruction: O ko O ummiino maayɓe, wuurtinoo nguurndam e kala ko O yiɗi, yimɓe, ɓalli walla leydi tan. | Quran: (22:7)

name-50.instruction: Seedoowo: Alla ko seedoowo cakkitiiɗo timmuɗo kala ko kewi e laamu O, e seereh laaɓɗe bayyine, meeñaane juumre. | Quran: (4:166)(22:17)(41:53)(48:28)

name-51.instruction: O ko O jogori Goonga alaa keerol. | Quran: (6:62)(22:6)(23:116)(24:25)

name-52.instruction: O ko O teeŋtinoo riziqi taguɓe, O mo alaa huunde e hakkilenaagu maɓɓe kala suuɗoo e O | Quran: (3:173)(4:171)(28:28)(73:9)

name-53.instruction: Sekaaɗo: Alla ko sekaaɗo ɓurɗo, tiiɗɗo ɓurɗo, fange O alaa keerol, siftetaa e siftinde fange ɓanndu. | Quran: (22:40)(22:74)(42:19)(57:25)

name-54.instruction: Doofɗo: doofgol moƴƴngol O, alaa keerol, alaa leemgol, alaa caale leemugol, alaa darrugol, alaa wakkati, alaa huunde yaasniinta. | Quran: (51:58)

name-55.instruction: O ko O mooftoo gollooɓe goongɗuɓe, nelaaɓe e jokkuɓe ɓe ko ɓe "yimɓe mooftaaɓe" e maanaa ɓe fewnaa e jokkondiral yaasi e O waɗɗo ɓe woodɓe, ko woni e jokkondiral e Alla | Quran: (4:45)(7:196)(42:28)(45:19)

name-56.instruction: O ko O foti jettaade, mawninde e jimol tanore ɓuri goɗɗo kala | Quran: (14:8)(31:12)(31:26)(41:42)

name-57.instruction: Firtaa e laawal: limooowo, kono maanaa O limoo taguɗo kala, gollal kala, ʋuuɓal ɓuuɓal kala e laamu O, alaa huunde doggi anndal O | Quran: (72:28)(78:29)(82:10-12)

name-58.instruction: O ko O hokkoo fuɗɗugol ko alaa alaa fuɗɗugol, alaa yeru, ko woni O tagɗo taguɓe | Quran: (10:34)(27:64)(29:19)(85:13)

name-59.instruction: O ko O ruttinoo nguurɓe e maayde ɓaawo nguurndam, O ruttinoo maayɓe e nguurndam ɓaawo maayde | Quran: (10:34)(27:64)(29:19)(85:13)

name-60.instruction: O ko O hokkoo nguurndam hawtugol maniyy, ko woni ndiyam jibinal, alaa neɗɗaagal, waɗoo ɗum neɗɗo nguurɗo, O hokkoo nguurndam ɓannduuji yimɓe, jinn e malaa'ika e hawtinde ɗi e neɗɗaagooji maɓɓe e sahaa ummugol | Quran: (7:158)(15:23)(30:50)(57:2)

name-61.instruction: O ko O waroo nguurɓe, O momtoo sekaa sekaaɓe aduna ɗoo e maayde | Quran: (3:156)(7:158)(15:23)(57:2)

name-62.instruction: Nguurɗo: O ko O artaa e woodgol kono O woodi, O jogori hayah, hallu ɗoo wonaa nguurndam no hayah taguɓe waɗaaɗe e hawtugol neɗɗaagal, ɓerɗe e ƴiiƴam. Imam At-Tahawiyy wiyi e deftere mum goongɗingal "mo ɓeydii e Alla hallu e maanaa ɗi waawi ɓeydeede e yimɓe ko goɗɗuɗo" | Quran: (2:255)(3:2)(25:58)(40:65)

name-63.instruction: O ko O woodi, duuɓiɗo, waylaa, O ko O alaa huunde bonnita walla momta, alaa laawal kala bonnita e laamude e tagude golle yimɓe | Quran: (2:255)(3:2)(20:111)

name-64.instruction: O ko O ɓaanaa huunde, O yettaa, O alaa e muuɗal, ŋakkeende walla koɗɗal | Quran: (38:44)

name-65.instruction: O ko O ɓuri goɗɗo kala moƴƴude, O hokkoo moƴƴe limeɗaaɗe no yaajniri alaa ruttoore | Quran: (11:73)

name-66.instruction: Gooto: O ko O alaa nannguɗo, e Ngonka O, e Gollal O, walla e Halluɗi O. Alaa huunde no O | Quran: (2:163)(5:73)(9:31)(18:110)

name-67.instruction: Gooto: O ko O jogori gootugol no hallu | Quran: (112:1)

name-68.instruction: O ko O min kaɗoo e mum e kala koɗɗal, O noddaa e koɗɗaɗe amin fow; O alaa ɓiɓɓe walla baabiiɓe, alaa nannguɗo walla diiɗo, e maanaa Al-Hakim; O ɓaanaɗo kala, O ko kala huunde muuɗi O woodde, e goɗɗum | Quran: (112:2)

name-69.instruction: O ko O alaa leemgol, O fange O timmii, laami taguɓe fow, O mo alaa huunde leemina | Quran: (6:65)(36:81)(46:33)(75:40)

name-70.instruction: O ko O sekaa dow kala huunde, O waawaaɗe O alaa keerol tiinɗo | Quran: (18:45)(54:42)(54:55)

name-71.instruction: O meeñaano e halluɗi taguɓe, ɓuri taguɗo kala moƴƴude; O yoɓɓoo yaawre kewuuji, yaawnoo koɗɗe wonɗe e gite yimɓe e sarde, hokkoo kala huunde kiis, daraja, wakkati e halluɗi moƴƴooɗi O e hikima | Quran: (16:61)(17:34)

name-72.instruction: O meeñaano e halluɗi taguɓe, ɓuri taguɗo kala moƴƴude; O yoɓɓoo leele kewuuji, leeloo koɗɗe wonɗe e gite yimɓe e sarde, hokkoo kala huunde kiis, daraja, wakkati e halluɗi moƴƴooɗi ɗum e hikima (yeeɓu no 71) | Quran: (71:4)

name-73.instruction: Fuɗɗoowo: O ko O woodi alaa taguɓe, alaa fuɗɗugol, alaa wakkati; O meeñaano tagaade, feeñde hallu keso e waylugol, O woodi alaa o arti e woodgol | Quran: (57:3)

name-74.instruction: Cakkitiiɗo: O ko O woodi alaa wakkati sahaa taguɓe bonnetee kala sahaa; O duuɓiɗo, O bonnoo, meeñaano bonneede e majjugol hallu gooto walla ɗuuɗɗu; O woodi alaa e miijoo cakkitugol e bonnugol | Quran: (57:3)

name-75.instruction: O ko woodgol O bayyinaa e kala huunde e seereh, e laawal sekaa e laamugol, alaa ko woodataa e ɓanndu kala e laawal nokku, bayyine e no | Quran: (57:3)

name-76.instruction: O ko O reenaa e mborre taguɓe etaade ɓeydude e Taguɗo halluɗi yimɓe walla halluɗi taguɓe, O tagɗo halluɗi taguɓe e bayyine maɓɓe | Quran: (57:3)

name-77.instruction: O ko O jogori, toppitoo, laami kala huunde, O tagoo kala huunde e hikima | Quran: (13:11)(22:7)

name-78.instruction: O ko O meeñaano e halluɗi taguɓe, O sekaa O dow taguɓe alaa keerol | Quran: (13:9)

name-79.instruction: O ko O waawi hokkude goongɗingal e barkeeji taguɓe fow, nder maɓɓe wonɓe njettii, wonɓe njettii: ɓee aranɓe ngyete muslimɓe walla goongɗuɓe, goɗɓe ngyete ngoɗɗuɓe | Quran: (52:28)

name-80.instruction: O ko O hokkoo yaafre ɓe tobubugii kala sahaa ɓe tobubugii | Quran: (2:128)(4:64)(49:12)(110:3)

name-82.instruction: O ko O dilloo, yaaf hakkee, O mooftoo e kala hakkilenaagu ɓaanaango dammugal teddungal, mooftugol e barkeeji walla tobubugol yaawngol | Quran: (4:99)(4:149)(22:60)

name-83.instruction: O ko O waawi hokkude heeɓugol moƴƴe alaa ruttoore, alaa muuɗal | Quran: (3:30)(9:117)(57:9)(59:10)

name-84.instruction: O ko O tagoo, ɓeydoo e sarde kala laamu, laamugol, jawdi e sekaa yaajngal fow hokkaaɗe taguɓe wonɗe e aduna ɗoo ɗow | Quran: (3:26)

name-85.instruction: Ko woni, Alla ko O ɓuri goɗɗo kala e goonga, seereh fow teeŋtinaa ɗum, haɗaa ɓatakee, woondaa jabbugol ɗoo, haɗde ɗum walla wondugol e ɗoo; O ko O heeɓnoo barkeeji ɓe faami ɗum, ɓe anndata cengol fow, heɓata yaljere, fewnetee no feewiri ñalnde Sarde | Quran: (55:27)(55:78)

name-86.instruction: O ko O sariyoo e goonga ɓurngol mawnude, O meeñaano e laawal kala tooñde e bonan, O alaa hisaab tiinɗo | Quran: (7:29)(3:18)

name-87.instruction: O ko O hawtino taguɓe e ñalnde alaa sikke nder mum, ñalnde Sarde | Quran: (3:9)

name-88.instruction: O ko O ɓaanaa taguɓe, taguɓe O waawaa woppude al-Ghaniyy [O ko O waɗɗo ɓe woodɓe, mooftoo ɓe woodɓe, wayloo ɓe sahaa fow] | Quran: (3:97)(39:7)(47:38)(57:24)

name-89.instruction: O ko O heeɓnoo koɗɗaɗe taguɓe, O ɓaddino ɓe riziqi maɓɓe | Quran: (9:28)

name-90.instruction: O ko O yoɓɓoo taguɗo kala yaljere mum, reentugol mum, O mo ɓe foti moofteeteede sahaa fow e sarde | Quran: (67:21)

name-91.instruction: O ko O sekaaɗo ɓaddinde tiinɗo caale nde foti yettaade taguɗo e sarde | Quran: (6:17)

name-92.instruction: O ko O sekaaɗo ɓaddinde tiinɗo nafa taguɗo foti heɓde e sarde | Quran: (30:37)

name-93.instruction: Lewru: O ko O fewino ɓe keɓi ɓaleel e faatngo maɓɓe, kaɗa ɓe e laawal goonga e sarde; Alla ko O fewinoo goongɗuɓe e lewru goongɗingal, tagoo lewru, wonaa lewru nde taguɗe tan | Quran: (24:35)

name-94.instruction: O ko O yoɓɓoo taguɓe wonɗe nafa fewneteede no feewiri, anndude goonga | Quran: (25:31)

name-95.instruction: O ko O ɓaddino taguɓe e aduna ɗoo e woodgol, alaa e kuugal ɓennungal walla e bayyine yeru ɓennundu, kono alaa artooowo, yeru e kewungu | Quran: (2:117)(6:101)

name-96.instruction: O ko woodgol O meeñaano bonnugol e waylugol, haɗaa e hakkilenaagu moƴƴaango mo waawaa jaggude ɓatakee | Quran: (55:27)

name-97.instruction: O ko O woodi, waylaa, sahaa taguɓe momtee | Quran: (15:23)

name-98.instruction: O ko O fewinoo taguɓe e ko ɓuri maɓɓe nafeede | Quran: (2:256)

name-99.instruction: O ko O ɓaawtinoo jaɓɓorgol hakkeeɓe e fewinde hisaabe kala haa ñalnde toɗɗaande, hokkoo ɓe yaasnde e wakkati haa wakkati mo ɓe fow anndaa date mum. | Quran: (2:153)(3:200)(103:3)
